title.zh_hant: 57歲男機場手提行李藏7公斤大麻花　市值146萬　明日提堂
title.en: 57-year-old man caught with 7 kg of cannabis buds in carry-on bag at airport; HK$1.46 million haul, court tomorrow
title.zh_hans: 57岁男机场手提行李藏7公斤大麻花　市值146万　明日提堂

summary.zh_hant: 海關今日在香港國際機場偵破一宗旅客販毒案，檢獲約7公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約146萬元。海關在機場進行緝毒行動期間，截查一名57歲內地男旅客，在其手提行李內發現一批懷疑大麻花，隨即將他拘捕。被捕男子已被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件將於明日（11月14日）在西九龍裁判法院提堂。海關表示會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，並提醒市民切勿為金錢報酬參與販毒，不要接受他人聘用或委託將受管制物品帶進或帶出香港，亦不要替他人攜帶不知名物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
summary.en: Hong Kong Customs today detected a drug trafficking case involving a passenger at Hong Kong International Airport, seizing about seven kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about $1.46 million. During an anti-narcotics operation at the airport, Customs officers intercepted a 57-year-old Mainland male passenger and found a batch of suspected cannabis buds inside his carry-on baggage, and arrested him. The arrested man has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug, and the case will be brought up at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts tomorrow (November 14). Customs said it will continue to step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis, and reminded the public not to take part in drug trafficking for monetary return, not to accept hiring or delegation to carry controlled items into or out of Hong Kong, and not to carry unknown items for other people. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in a dangerous drug is a serious offence, punishable on conviction by a maximum fine of $5 million and life imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 海关今日在香港国际机场侦破一宗旅客贩毒案，检获约7公斤怀疑大麻花，估计市值约146万元。海关在机场进行缉毒行动期间，截查一名57岁内地男旅客，在其手提行李内发现一批怀疑大麻花，随即将他拘捕。被捕男子已被控一项贩运危险药物罪，案件将于明日（11月14日）在西九龙裁判法院提堂。海关表示会继续透过情报分析加强打击贩毒活动，并提醒市民切勿为金钱报酬参与贩毒，不要接受他人聘用或委托将受管制物品带进或带出香港，亦不要替他人携带不知名物品。根据《危险药物条例》，贩运危险药物属严重罪行，一经定罪最高可被判罚款500万元及终身监禁。

title.zh_hant: 衞生署署長會見國家藥檢院院長　加強藥品監管合作　36項中藥標準已制定
title.en: Director of Health meets national drug control chief to deepen regulatory co-operation; 36 Chinese medicine standards set
title.zh_hans: 卫生署署长会见国家药检院院长　加强药品监管合作　36项中药标准已制定

summary.zh_hant: 衞生署署長林文健醫生今日會見到訪的國家藥品監督管理局藥品檢驗研究院院長安福東及代表團，雙方同意進一步加強在藥品監管、資訊數碼轉型及生物製品檢測能力建設等範疇的合作與交流。雙方討論了《中醫藥發展五年行動計劃（2026-2030）》、中醫藥發展、政府中藥檢測中心及《醫療產品規管條例草案》。自2024年簽署《中藥標準研究及中藥標本合作協議》以來，雙方透過技術、人才及學術交流不斷加強聯繫；今年8月，藥品檢驗研究院為衞生署及政府化驗所專業人員舉辦為期4星期的生物製品檢測培訓。藥品檢驗研究院及其指定的內地檢測機構積極參與香港中藥材標準計劃，至今已制定36項中藥材參考標準，並指定多間市級藥品檢驗機構為香港中成藥註冊的認可檢測機構，以及向香港提供藥品標準物質。林文健亦向代表團介紹衞生署將於今年成立的醫療產品規管中心，將系統整合西藥、中藥及醫療器械的規管職能，全面提升科學規管能力，完善醫療產品審批機制，支持香港發展成為國際健康及醫療創新樞紐。
summary.en: Director of Health Dr Ronald Lam today met Mr An Fudong, Director General of the National Institutes for Drug Control (NIDC), and his delegation, and they agreed to further strengthen co-operation and exchanges in drug regulation, digital transformation of information and capacity building in the testing of biological products. The two sides discussed the Five-Year Action Plan for the Development of Chinese Medicine (2026-2030), the development of Chinese medicine, the Government Chinese Medicines Testing Institute and the Medical Products Regulation Bill. Since signing the Co-operation Agreement on Research of Chinese Medicines Standards and on Chinese Medicines Herbarium in 2024, the two sides have deepened ties through technical, talent and academic exchanges; in August this year, the NIDC offered a four-week training programme on testing of biological products to professionals from the Department of Health and the Government Laboratory. The NIDC and its designated testing institutions in the Mainland have actively participated in the Hong Kong Chinese Materia Medica Standards Project, formulating reference standards for 36 Chinese Materia Medica so far, designating a number of municipal Institutes for Drug Control as recognised testing institutes for registration of proprietary Chinese medicines in Hong Kong, and supplying drug reference materials to Hong Kong. Dr Lam also briefed the delegation on the Centre for Medical Products Regulation, which the department will establish this year to systematically consolidate regulatory functions for Western and Chinese medicines as well as medical devices, comprehensively enhancing scientific regulation capacity and improving the review and approval mechanism for medical products, supporting Hong Kong's development as an international health and medical innovation hub.
summary.zh_hans: 卫生署署长林文健医生今日会见到访的国家药品监督管理局药品检验研究院院长安福东及代表团，双方同意进一步加强在药品监管、资讯数码转型及生物制品检测能力建设等范畴的合作与交流。双方讨论了《中医药发展五年行动计划（2026-2030）》、中医药发展、政府中药检测中心及《医疗产品规管条例草案》。自2024年签署《中药标准研究及中药标本合作协议》以来，双方透过技术、人才及学术交流不断加强联系；今年8月，药品检验研究院为卫生署及政府化验所专业人员举办为期4星期的生物制品检测培训。药品检验研究院及其指定的内地检测机构积极参与香港中药材标准计划，至今已制定36项中药材参考标准，并指定多间市级药品检验机构为香港中成药注册的认可检测机构，以及向香港提供药品标准物质。林文健亦向代表团介绍卫生署将于今年成立的医疗产品规管中心，将系统整合西药、中药及医疗器械的规管职能，全面提升科学规管能力，完善医疗产品审批机制，支持香港发展成为国际健康及医疗创新枢纽。

title.en: Scoop Goddess Maggie Leung trains hard for TVB anniversary 400m race, pelvis narrows 6.7cm and 'false wide hips' gone
title.zh_hant: 東張女神梁敏巧為台慶400米狂操 盆骨收窄6.7cm 假胯寬拜拜
title.zh_hans: 东张女神梁敏巧为台庆400米狂操 盆骨收窄6.7cm 假胯宽拜拜

summary.en:
TVB Scoop host Maggie Leung, known as the 'Scoop Goddess', recently filmed print and video advertisements for La Health, promoting the clinic's traditional Chinese medicine posture-repair combination treatment. Leung tried the 'pelvic narrowing and buttock slimming' treatment and the 'instant pain relief' treatment on the spot — the former uses a proprietary technique with OUSI equipment to narrow the pelvis and slim the buttocks, while the latter provides immediate pain relief. She is also one of six 'Scoop Goddesses' competing in TVB's 59th anniversary 'Scoop Goddess Cup' 400-metre race on 19 November.

With the anniversary approaching, Leung said in an interview that both her looks and figure need to be ready, so she tried several treatments. She first did acupoint thread-embedding: 'The first time I did it two or three times. Besides my waist, I also had thread-embedding on my arms, thighs and other areas. Over the whole course I lost thirty centimetres.' The thirty centimetres is her own words, referring to the cumulative figure across her waist, arms, thighs and other areas over the whole course, not a single area.

She then did the pelvic narrowing treatment. Leung said many women have the problem of 'false wide hips': 'After one session I had already lost 3.2 centimetres. After completing the whole course, my pelvis narrowed by a total of 6.7 centimetres, and my false wide hips improved.' Besides her figure, she said her face also needs to look good, so she also tried the Korean water-glow bare-skin needle treatment: 'After doing it, I actually think I look very good now.'
summary.zh_hant:
無綫《東張西望》主持梁敏巧（Maggie）有「東張女神」之稱，近日為立康醫療拍攝平面及視頻廣告，推廣其中醫體態修復組合療程。Maggie即場試做「盆骨收窄小臀術」及痛症療程「痛即消」，前者以獨門手法配合OUSI儀器收窄盆骨、塑造小臀效果，後者即時紓緩痛症。佢亦係無綫台慶59周年「東張女神盃」六位參賽跑女之一，將於11月19日台慶當晚出戰400米賽跑。

臨近台慶，Maggie話樣貌同身材都要一齊準備，先後試咗幾樣療程。佢話首先做咗穴位埋線，「第一次做的時候做了兩三次，除了腰之外，手臂、大腿等也有做過穴位埋線，整個療程瘦了三十厘米。」三十厘米係佢原話，指成個療程喺腰、手臂、大腿等多個部位累計嘅數字，唔係單一部位。

之後佢再做盆骨收窄術。Maggie話好多女生都有「假胯寬」嘅問題，「做完一次之後我已經瘦了3.2厘米，做完整個療程總共收窄了6.7厘米，啲假胯寬都改善咗。」除咗身形，佢話樣都要靚，所以亦做咗韓方水光素顏針，「做完之後，其實我覺得而家見到我都好靚。」
summary.zh_hans:
无线《东张西望》主持梁敏巧（Maggie）有「东张女神」之称，近日为立康医疗拍摄平面及视频广告，推广其中医体态修复组合疗程。Maggie即场试做「盆骨收窄小臀术」及痛症疗程「痛即消」，前者以独门手法配合OUSI仪器收窄盆骨、塑造小臀效果，后者即时纾缓痛症。她亦是无线台庆59周年「东张女神杯」六位参赛跑女之一，将于11月19日台庆当晚出战400米赛跑。

临近台庆，Maggie在访问中说，样貌和身材都要一起准备，先后试了几样疗程。她说首先做了穴位埋线，「第一次做的时候做了两三次，除了腰之外，手臂、大腿等也有做过穴位埋线，整个疗程瘦了三十厘米。」三十厘米是她原话，指整个疗程在腰、手臂、大腿等多个部位累计的数字，不是单一部位。

之后她再做盆骨收窄术。Maggie说很多女生都有「假胯宽」的问题，「做完一次之后我已经瘦了3.2厘米，做完整个疗程总共收窄了6.7厘米，假胯宽都改善了。」除了身形，她说样子也要靓，所以亦做了韩方水光素颜针，「做完之后，其实我觉得现在见到我都好靓。」

title.zh_hant: 內地客攜2萬支未完稅煙闖關　西九龍裁判法院判囚4個月罰款2000元
title.en: Mainland passenger jailed four months for smuggling 20,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes through Hong Kong airport
title.zh_hans: 内地客携2万支未完税烟闯关　西九龙裁判法院判囚4个月罚款2000元

summary.zh_hant: 一名入境男旅客今日（11月13日）在西九龍裁判法院被判監禁4個月及罰款2,000元，罪名是進口未完稅香煙及未有向海關人員申報，違反《應課稅品條例》。海關人員昨日（11月12日）在香港國際機場截查一名37歲內地男旅客，他由柬埔寨金邊經越南胡志明市抵港，海關在其個人行李搜出約2萬支未完稅香煙，估計市值約9萬元，應課稅值約6.6萬元，該名旅客隨後被捕。海關歡迎判刑，認為監禁刑罰具相當阻嚇作用，反映罪行嚴重性，並提醒市民香煙屬應課稅品，進口、處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙均屬違法，一經定罪最高可被罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
summary.en: An incoming male passenger was sentenced to four months' imprisonment and fined $2,000 by the West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today (November 13) for importing duty-not-paid cigarettes and failing to declare them to Customs officers, in contravention of the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance. Customs officers intercepted a 37-year-old Mainland male passenger arriving at Hong Kong International Airport yesterday (November 12) from Phnom Penh, Cambodia, via Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and seized about 20,000 duty-not-paid cigarettes from his personal baggage, with an estimated market value of about $90,000 and a duty potential of about $66,000; the passenger was subsequently arrested. Customs welcomed the sentence, saying the custodial term has a considerable deterrent effect and reflects the seriousness of the offences, and reminded the public that cigarettes are dutiable goods and that importing, dealing in, possessing, selling or buying illicit cigarettes is an offence, punishable on conviction by a maximum fine of $2 million and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hans: 一名入境男旅客今日（11月13日）在西九龙裁判法院被判监禁4个月及罚款2,000元，罪名是进口未完税香烟及未有向海关人员申报，违反《应课税品条例》。海关人员昨日（11月12日）在香港国际机场截查一名37岁内地男旅客，他由柬埔寨金边经越南胡志明市抵港，海关在其个人行李搜出约2万支未完税香烟，估计市值约9万元，应课税值约6.6万元，该名旅客随后被捕。海关欢迎判刑，认为监禁刑罚具相当阻吓作用，反映罪行严重性，并提醒市民香烟属应课税品，进口、处理、管有、售卖或购买私烟均属违法，一经定罪最高可被罚款200万元及监禁7年。

title.zh_hant: 入境處連環反黑工行動　突擊餐廳裝修單位按摩院　拘15人包括僱主
title.en: Immigration Department sweeps net 15 in anti-illegal worker operations across restaurants, flats and massage parlours
title.zh_hans: 入境处连环反黑工行动　突击餐厅装修单位按摩院　拘15人包括雇主

summary.zh_hant: 入境處11月9日至昨日（11月12日）展開全港反非法勞工行動，代號「Twilight」、「Fastrack」及「Lightshadow」，並與警方展開代號「Champion」的聯合行動，突擊多個目標地點，包括餐廳、裝修中單位及按摩院，共拘捕15人，包括12名疑似非法勞工、1名疑似僱主及2名逾期逗留人士。被捕疑似非法勞工為2男10女，年齡31至58歲，其中1名男子持有不允許受僱的擔保書，2名女子涉嫌使用及管有偽造香港身份證；43歲女子涉嫌聘用非法勞工被捕；2名逾期逗留女子分別42及46歲。當局表示會繼續調查疑似僱主，不排除再有人被捕。
summary.en: The Immigration Department mounted a series of territory-wide anti-illegal worker operations from November 9 to yesterday (November 12), codenamed "Twilight", "Fastrack" and "Lightshadow", together with joint operations with police codenamed "Champion", raiding multiple target locations including restaurants, flats under renovation and massage parlours, and arresting 15 people: 12 suspected illegal workers, one suspected employer and two overstayers. The arrested suspected illegal workers comprised two men and 10 women, aged 31 to 58; one man was holding a recognisance form prohibiting employment, and two women were suspected of using and possessing a forged Hong Kong identity card; a 43-year-old woman suspected of employing the illegal workers was also arrested; the two overstayers were women aged 42 and 46. The department said investigations into the suspected employers are ongoing and further arrests are not ruled out.
summary.zh_hans: 入境处11月9日至昨日（11月12日）展开全港反非法劳工行动，代号「Twilight」、「Fastrack」及「Lightshadow」，并与警方展开代号「Champion」的联合行动，突击多个目标地点，包括餐厅、装修中单位及按摩院，共拘捕15人，包括12名疑似非法劳工、1名疑似雇主及2名逾期逗留人士。被捕疑似非法劳工为2男10女，年龄31至58岁，其中1名男子持有不允许受雇的担保书，2名女子涉嫌使用及管有伪造香港身份证；43岁女子涉嫌聘用非法劳工被捕；2名逾期逗留女子分别42及46岁。当局表示会继续调查疑似雇主，不排除再有人被捕。

title.en: Mao Hamasaki returns to work after suspected drugging, praises Mak Pui Tung in Cantonese debut on HOY sitcom
title.zh_hant: 濱崎真緒疑遭落藥後復工 廣東話拍《李寶安》讚麥沛東勁
title.zh_hans: 滨崎真绪疑遭落药后复工 广东话拍《李宝安》赞麦沛东厉害

summary.en: Former Japanese AV actress Mao Hamasaki was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital's intensive care unit on 1 November after she was suspected of being drugged while working at a Tsim Sha Tsui entertainment venue, with four drugs detected in her system; police arrested a 61-year-old man on 2 November on suspicion of administering poison. She was discharged the next day and, after recovering, returned to work, saying on social media on 10 November that she had recovered. She guest-starred in HOY sitcom 'Your Security Guard Lee Bo On' episode 10, 'A Fortunate Encounter with Mao', taking on her first all-Cantonese role, and said every line had to be understood first and then memorised for pronunciation, with Yeung Chi Man coaching her in colloquial Cantonese beforehand. She praised co-star Mak Pui Tung's acting, saying his exaggerated, funny style brought her into the role, and, having obtained her Hong Kong identity card in May this year and settled in Hong Kong, said she hoped for more chances to work here, while reminding everyone to stay alert and watch their drinks when out.
summary.zh_hant: 前日本AV女優濱崎真緒11月1日凌晨在尖沙咀一間娛樂場所工作期間懷疑遭人落藥，飲下兩杯雞尾酒後約一小時突然失去意識、全身抽搐，送往伊利沙伯醫院深切治療部搶救，體內驗出四種毒品反應；警方11月2日在中區拘捕一名61歲男子，涉嫌施用毒藥。她留院一日後出院，休養後已經復工，11月10日在社交平台表示已康復。復工後她客串HOY處境劇《你的保安 李寶安》第10集《幸福の崎遇》，首次挑戰全廣東話演出，坦言每句對白都要先理解意思再記發音，事前獲楊詩敏傳授地道廣東話。她大讚拍檔麥沛東演技厲害，兩人大量對手戲，麥沛東誇張搞笑的演法帶動她入戲；她今年5月取得香港身份證並定居香港，希望以後有更多機會在港發展，並提醒大家出外要小心、看管好飲品。
summary.zh_hans: 前日本AV女优滨崎真绪11月1日凌晨在尖沙咀一间娱乐场所工作期间怀疑遭人落药，饮下两杯鸡尾酒后约一小时突然失去意识、全身抽搐，送往伊利沙伯医院深切治疗部抢救，体内验出四种毒品反应；警方11月2日在中区拘捕一名61岁男子，涉嫌施用毒药。她留院一日后出院，休养后已经复工，11月10日在社交平台表示已康复。复工后她客串HOY处境剧《你的保安 李宝安》第10集《幸福の崎遇》，首次挑战全广东话演出，坦言每句对白都要先理解意思再记发音，事前获杨诗敏传授地道广东话。她大赞拍档麦沛东演技厉害，两人大量对手戏，麦沛东夸张搞笑的演法带动她入戏；她今年5月取得香港身份证并定居香港，希望以后有更多机会在港发展，并提醒大家出外要小心、看管好饮品。

title.zh_hant: 亞裔民族文化匯演下周六免費入場　30國歌舞美食齊聚文化中心
title.en: Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances carnival next Saturday: free entry, 30 countries bring song, dance and food to Cultural Centre
title.zh_hans: 亚裔民族文化汇演下周六免费入场　30国歌舞美食齐聚文化中心

summary.zh_hant: 戶外嘉年華「亞裔民族文化匯演+ 2026」將於11月22日下午2時至6時在香港文化中心露天廣場及大堂舉行，免費入場。活動是「亞藝無疆」藝術節2026壓軸節目，匯聚約30個「一帶一路」國家及地區代表，包括孟加拉、白俄羅斯、文萊、柬埔寨、埃及、匈牙利、印尼、伊朗、哈薩克、韓國、科威特、老撾、馬來西亞、緬甸、尼泊爾、尼日利亞、巴基斯坦、菲律賓、卡塔爾、俄羅斯、沙特阿拉伯、新加坡、斯里蘭卡、泰國、土耳其、烏拉圭、越南及津巴布韋等，現場有不同民族歌舞表演、文化攤位及工作坊，展示各地手工藝及特色小食。同期11月22日至29日在文化中心大堂舉行八日民族文化展覽，展出編織、油畫及瓷器等手工藝品。
summary.en: The outdoor carnival Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ 2026 will be held on November 22 from 2pm to 6pm at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza and Foyer, with free admission. The event is the finale programme of the Asia+ Festival 2026, bringing together representatives from around 30 Belt and Road countries and regions, including Bangladesh, Belarus, Brunei Darussalam, Cambodia, Egypt, Hungary, Indonesia, Iran, Kazakhstan, Korea, Kuwait, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, the Philippines, Qatar, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Türkiye, Uruguay, Vietnam and Zimbabwe, with dance and music performances of different ethnic styles, cultural booths and workshops presenting crafts and signature snacks from various places. An eight-day ethnic cultural exhibition will also run from November 22 to 29 at the Cultural Centre Foyer, featuring handicrafts including woven textiles, oil paintings and porcelains.
summary.zh_hans: 户外嘉年华「亚裔民族文化汇演+ 2026」将于11月22日下午2时至6时在香港文化中心露天广场及大堂举行，免费入场。活动是「亚艺无疆」艺术节2026压轴节目，汇聚约30个「一带一路」国家及地区代表，包括孟加拉、白俄罗斯、文莱、柬埔寨、埃及、匈牙利、印尼、伊朗、哈萨克、韩国、科威特、老挝、马来西亚、缅甸、尼泊尔、尼日利亚、巴基斯坦、菲律宾、卡塔尔、俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯、新加坡、斯里兰卡、泰国、土耳其、乌拉圭、越南及津巴布韦等，现场有不同民族歌舞表演、文化摊位及工作坊，展示各地手工艺及特色小食。同期11月22日至29日在文化中心大堂举行八日民族文化展览，展出编织、油画及瓷器等手工艺品。

title.zh_hant: 14歲女童馬鞍山失蹤　蕭樂瑤離家兩日未歸　警方呼籲市民提供消息
title.en: 14-year-old girl missing in Ma On Shan: Siu Lok-yiu left home two days ago, police appeal for information
title.zh_hans: 14岁女童马鞍山失踪　萧乐瑶离家两日未归　警方呼吁市民提供消息

summary.zh_hant: 警方今日呼籲市民提供在馬鞍山失蹤女童的消息。蕭樂瑤，14歲，11月11日早上離開耀安邨住所後失蹤，家人同日報案。她約1.5米高、約40公斤、瘦身材、尖面、黃皮膚、長黑髮；最後露面時穿白恤衫、藍裙、深色外套、黑色皮鞋，攜黑色背囊。任何人如知道失蹤女童的下落或曾見過她，請致電新界南總區失蹤人口調查組3661 1173，或電郵至rmpu-nts-2@police.gov.hk，或聯絡任何警署。
summary.en: Police today appealed to the public for information on a girl who went missing in Ma On Shan. Siu Lok-yiu, aged 14, went missing after she left her residence in Yiu On Estate on the morning of November 11, and her family reported her missing the same day. She is about 1.5 metres tall, around 40 kilograms in weight and of thin build, with a sharp face, yellow complexion and long black hair. She was last seen wearing a white shirt, a blue skirt, a dark-coloured jacket and black leather shoes, carrying a black backpack. Anyone who knows the whereabouts of the missing girl or may have seen her is urged to contact the Regional Missing Persons Unit of New Territories South on 3661 1173, email rmpu-nts-2@police.gov.hk, or contact any police station.
summary.zh_hans: 警方今日呼吁市民提供在马鞍山失踪女童的消息。萧乐瑶，14岁，11月11日早上离开耀安邨住所后失踪，家人同日报案。她约1.5米高、约40公斤、瘦身材、尖面、黄皮肤、长黑发；最后露面时穿白恤衫、蓝裙、深色外套、黑色皮鞋，携黑色背囊。任何人如知道失踪女童的下落或曾见过她，请致电新界南总区失踪人口调查组3661 1173，或电邮至rmpu-nts-2@police.gov.hk，或联络任何警署。

title.zh_hant: 謝展寰COP31馬拉松式會晤　晤黃潤秋談減碳綠色金融　今午返港
title.en: Tse Chin-wan holds marathon meetings at COP31, discusses decarbonisation and green finance with Huang Runqiu, returns to Hong Kong this afternoon
title.zh_hans: 谢展寰COP31马拉松式会晤　晤黄润秋谈减碳绿色金融　今午返港

summary.zh_hant: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰於11月11及12日（安塔利亞時間）繼續在土耳其安塔利亞出席《聯合國氣候變化框架公約》締約方大會第31屆會議，先後與生態環境部部長黃潤秋、中國代表團團長兼生態環境部副部長李高、韓國仁川代表文真，以及宜可城—地方政府可持續發展協會秘書長和世界自然保護聯盟副總幹事會面，討論能源轉型、氫能發展、減碳策略及綠色金融等議題。謝展寰亦出席香港工程師學會酒會並發表主題演講，介紹香港減碳策略及進展；氣候變化專員楊秀權則出席聯合國貿發會議召集的全球碳市場網絡啟動儀式並致辭。謝展寰已於11月12日（安塔利亞時間）晚上啟程回港，今日下午抵港。
summary.en: Secretary for Environment and Ecology Tse Chin-wan continued to attend the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, on November 11 and 12 (Antalya time), meeting Ecology and Environment Minister Huang Runqiu, Chinese delegation head and Vice Minister Li Gao, Incheon representative Jin Moon, and the heads of ICLEI and the International Union for Conservation of Nature to discuss energy transition, hydrogen development, decarbonisation strategy and green finance. Tse also addressed a Hong Kong Institution of Engineers reception on Hong Kong's carbon reduction strategy, while Commissioner for Climate Change Sammy Yeung spoke at the launch of a UN Trade and Development global carbon market network. Tse left on the evening of November 12 (Antalya time) and arrives in Hong Kong this afternoon.
summary.zh_hans: 环境及生态局局长谢展寰于11月11及12日（安塔利亚时间）继续在土耳其安塔利亚出席《联合国气候变化框架公约》缔约方大会第31届会议，先后与生态环境部部长黄润秋、中国代表团团长兼生态环境部副部长李高、韩国仁川代表文真，以及宜可城—地方政府可持续发展协会秘书长和世界自然保护联盟副总干事会面，讨论能源转型、氢能发展、减碳策略及绿色金融等议题。谢展寰亦出席香港工程师学会酒会并发表主题演讲，介绍香港减碳策略及进展；气候变化专员杨秀权则出席联合国贸发会议召集的全球碳市场网络启动仪式并致辞。谢展寰已于11月12日（安塔利亚时间）晚上启程回港，今日下午抵港。

title.en: Woman Arrested for Impersonating Bank Staff in Debt Restructuring Scam, Defrauding 6 People of HK$4.9 Million
title.zh_hant: 扮銀行職員呃債務重組 女子騙6人490萬被捕
title.zh_hans: 扮银行职员呃债务重组 女子骗6人490万被捕

summary.en: Three victims reported receiving calls from fraudsters impersonating bank staff, claiming they could help with debt restructuring. The victims met people posing as accounting firm staff at shared offices in Mong Kok and Cheung Sha Wan and handed over money, only to find their debts unchanged. Police reviewed CCTV and intelligence and arrested a 45-year-old unemployed woman in Sham Shui Po on Tuesday (10th), seizing about HK$1 million in cash believed to be proceeds of the fraud. Police believe she is linked to at least six similar cases involving about HK$4.9 million, with the largest single loss around HK$2.8 million. She has been charged with conspiracy to defraud and appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts yesterday.
summary.zh_hant: 3名事主早前報案，指收到偽冒銀行職員來電，訛稱可協助債務重組。事主按指示到旺角及長沙灣共享辦公室，與自稱會計師樓職員會面並交錢，之後發現債務毫無變動，始知受騙。警方翻查閉路電視及情報分析，周二（10日）在深水埗拘捕一名45歲無業女子，身上搜出約100萬元現金，相信為騙款。警方相信她至少涉及6宗同類案件，騙取約490萬元，最大單一損失約280萬元。被捕女子被控一項串謀詐騙罪，昨日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
summary.zh_hans: 3名事主早前报案，指收到伪冒银行职员来电，讹称可协助债务重组。事主按指示到旺角及长沙湾共享办公室，与自称会计师楼职员会面并交钱，之后发现债务毫无变动，始知受骗。警方翻查闭路电视及情报分析，周二（10日）在深水埗拘捕一名45岁无业女子，身上搜出约100万元现金，相信为骗款。警方相信她至少涉及6宗同类案件，骗取约490万元，最大单一损失约280万元。被捕女子被控一项串谋诈骗罪，昨日在西九龙裁判法院提堂。

title.en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns as CEO effective immediately; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
title.zh_hant: 輝達震撼換帥　黃仁勳即日辭任行政總裁　財務總監暫代掌舵
title.zh_hans: 辉达震撼换帅　黄仁勋即日辞任行政总裁　财务总监暂代掌舵

summary.en: Nvidia's board has announced that founder Jensen Huang has resigned as president, chief executive officer and a member of the board, effective immediately, ending his 33-year tenure at the helm. The board has launched a formal search for a permanent CEO, considering both internal and external candidates. Until a successor is named, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO, and Harvey C. Jones has been appointed as the company's first-ever chair of the board. The board thanked Huang for his contributions over 33 years and said it expects operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap to continue without interruption. Kress has led Nvidia's finance team since September 2013, after nearly 25 years in finance roles at Cisco and Microsoft; Jones has more than 30 years of experience as an entrepreneur, technology executive and venture investor, and previously served as executive chairman and CEO of Synopsys.
summary.zh_hant: 輝達董事會宣布，創辦人黃仁勳即日起辭去總裁、行政總裁及董事職務，結束 33 年掌舵生涯。董事會已啟動正式行政總裁遴選程序，將同時考慮內部及外部人選；在正式繼任人出爐前，由執行副總裁兼財務總監 Colette Kress 暫代行政總裁，並任命 Harvey C. Jones 為公司首位董事會主席。聲明感謝黃仁勳過去 33 年的貢獻，強調公司營運、客戶承諾及產品路線圖將繼續順利推進。Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起領導集團財務團隊，此前在思科及微軟從事財務工作近 25 年；Jones 擁有逾 30 年企業家、科技主管及創投經驗，曾任新思科技執行主席兼行政總裁。
summary.zh_hans: 辉达董事会宣布，创办人黄仁勋即日起辞去总裁、行政总裁及董事职务，结束 33 年掌舵生涯。董事会已启动正式行政总裁遴选程序，将同时考虑内部及外部人选；在正式继任人出炉前，由执行副总裁兼财务总监 Colette Kress 暂代行政总裁，并任命 Harvey C. Jones 为公司首位董事会主席。声明感谢黄仁勋过去 33 年的贡献，强调公司营运、客户承诺及产品路线图将继续顺利推进。Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起领导集团财务团队，此前在思科及微软从事财务工作近 25 年；Jones 拥有逾 30 年企业家、科技主管及创投经验，曾任新思科技执行主席兼行政总裁。

title.en: 13-year-old boy allegedly assaulted at Heng Fa Chuen school; Education Bureau orders follow-up, no arrests yet
title.zh_hant: 杏花邨13歲男生校內疑被襲　教育局要求學校跟進　暫未有人被捕
title.zh_hans: 杏花邨13岁男生校内疑被袭　教育局要求学校跟进　暂未有人被捕

summary.en: A 13-year-old boy was allegedly struck by hand at Lingnan Secondary School in Heng Fa Chuen on Tuesday (10 November) and was taken to hospital conscious for examination. Police have classified the case as common assault and assigned it to the Eastern District anti-triad unit; no arrests have been made. The school said it activated its crisis-management mechanism immediately after learning of the incident, investigated and contacted the parents, and accompanied them to report the matter to police the next day. The school said it is fully cooperating with the police investigation, staying in close contact with the Education Bureau, and will provide appropriate support to the students involved. The Education Bureau has asked the school to follow up.
summary.zh_hant: 杏花邨嶺南中學一名13歲男生，本周二（10日）在校內懷疑被人用手襲擊，事後清醒送院檢查。警方初步調查後將案件列為「普通襲擊」，交由東區警區反三合會行動組跟進，暫未有人被捕。校方稱知悉事件後即時啟動危機處理機制調查，並聯絡涉事學生家長，翌日陪同家長報警；校方表示會全力配合警方調查，與教育局保持緊密聯繫，並為相關學生提供適切支援。教育局已要求學校跟進事件。
summary.zh_hans: 杏花邨岭南中学一名13岁男生，本周二（10日）在校内怀疑被人用手袭击，事后清醒送院检查。警方初步调查后将案件列为「普通袭击」，交由东区警区反三合会行动组跟进，暂未有人被捕。校方称知悉事件后即时启动危机处理机制调查，并联络涉事学生家长，翌日陪同家长报警；校方表示会全力配合警方调查，与教育局保持紧密联系，并为相关学生提供適切支援。教育局已要求学校跟进事件。

title.zh_hant: 美國10月PPI按年升6.5%創近4年新高　按月升幅顯著放緩
title.en: US October PPI rises 6.5% year on year, fastest in nearly four years, as monthly gain slows sharply
title.zh_hans: 美国10月PPI按年升6.5%创近4年新高　按月升幅显著放缓

summary.zh_hant: 美國10月上游物價通脹率創近4年新高，物價按月升幅則顯著放緩。10月最終需求生產物價指數按年升幅加快至6.5%，略低於市場預期；撇除食品及能源的核心生產物價指數按年升幅維持5%，符合預期。按月比較，生產物價指數升0.3%，升幅略低於預期，比9月的1.4%顯著放緩；核心生產物價指數按月升0.3%，符合預期，升幅比9月的0.8%有所放緩。
summary.en: US upstream price inflation hit its highest in nearly four years in October, though the monthly increase slowed sharply. The final-demand producer price index rose 6.5 per cent year on year in October, slightly below market expectations; core PPI, excluding food and energy, rose 5 per cent year on year, in line with expectations. Month on month, PPI rose 0.3 per cent, slightly below expectations and sharply slower than September's 1.4 per cent; core PPI rose 0.3 per cent month on month, in line with expectations and slower than September's 0.8 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 美国10月上游物价通胀率创近4年新高，物价按月升幅则显著放缓。10月最终需求生产物价指数按年升幅加快至6.5%，略低于市场预期；撇除食品及能源的核心生产物价指数按年升幅维持5%，符合预期。按月比较，生产物价指数升0.3%，升幅略低于预期，比9月的1.4%显著放缓；核心生产物价指数按月升0.3%，符合预期，升幅比9月的0.8%有所放缓。

title.zh_hant: 失蹤兩日終尋回！14歲女童蕭樂瑤天水圍現身　無受傷無可疑
title.en: Missing 14-year-old girl Siu Lok-yiu found safe in Tin Shui Wai after two days
title.zh_hans: 失踪两日终寻回！14岁女童萧乐瑶天水围现身　无受伤无可疑

summary.zh_hant: 警方表示，14歲少女蕭樂瑤星期三（11月11日）早上離開馬鞍山耀安邨住所後失蹤，家人同日報案。警方今日（11月13日）下午在天水圍天瑞邨尋回她，她沒有受傷，案件亦沒有可疑情況。警方早前曾發出呼籲，呼籲市民提供消息協助尋找該名女童。
summary.en: Police said 14-year-old Siu Lok-yiu went missing after leaving her home in Yiu On Estate, Ma On Shan, on the morning of Wednesday (November 11), and her family reported her missing the same day. She was located in Tin Shui Estate, Tin Shui Wai, this afternoon (November 13). She sustained no injuries and no suspicious circumstances were detected. Police had earlier appealed to the public for information to help find her.
summary.zh_hans: 警方表示，14岁少女萧乐瑶星期三（11月11日）早上离开马鞍山耀安邨住所后失踪，家人同日报案。警方今日（11月13日）下午在天水围天瑞邨寻回她，她没有受伤，案件亦没有可疑情况。警方早前曾发出呼吁，呼吁市民提供消息协助寻找该名女童。

title.zh_hant: 又爆校園襲擊！柴灣11歲男生疑校內被打傷　警列刑案暫無人被捕
title.en: 11-year-old boy allegedly assaulted at Chai Wan school; police classify case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm, no arrests yet
title.zh_hans: 又爆校园袭击！柴湾11岁男生疑校内被打伤　警列刑案暂无人被捕

summary.zh_hant: 警方早前接報，指一名11歲男生上月21日在柴灣一間學校內懷疑被人用手襲擊，男童報稱受傷，送往東區醫院治理。警方經初步調查後，將案件列為「襲擊致造成身體傷害」，由東區警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進，暫時未有人被捕。教育局表示十分關注事件，接獲學校通報後已提醒學校嚴肅跟進，為有需要學生提供支援及輔導；學校已啟動危機處理小組跟進，並與有關學生家長保持聯繫。教育局重申對校園欺凌採取「零容忍」政策。
summary.en: Police received a report earlier that an 11-year-old boy was allegedly assaulted by hand at a school in Chai Wan on October 21. The boy reported being injured and was taken to Eastern Hospital for treatment. After a preliminary investigation, police classified the case as assault occasioning actual bodily harm; it is being followed up by the first team of the Eastern District Criminal Investigation Unit, and no arrests have been made so far. The Education Bureau said it is very concerned about the incident and, after receiving the school's report, reminded the school to follow up seriously and provide support and counselling to students in need; the school has activated its crisis management team and is liaising with the parents concerned. The bureau reiterated its zero-tolerance policy on school bullying.
summary.zh_hans: 警方早前接报，指一名11岁男生上月21日在柴湾一间学校内怀疑被人用手袭击，男童报称受伤，送往东区医院治理。警方经初步调查后，将案件列为「袭击致造成身体伤害」，由东区警区刑事调查队第一队跟进，暂时未有人被捕。教育局表示十分关注事件，接获学校通报后已提醒学校严肃跟进，为有需要学生提供支援及辅导；学校已启动危机处理小组跟进，并与有关学生家长保持联系。教育局重申对校园欺凌采取「零容忍」政策。

title.zh_hant: 王毅晤韓外長趙顯：中韓關係重回改善軌道　期待下周深圳APEC領袖會晤
title.en: Wang Yi meets South Korean foreign minister Cho Hyun: China-South Korea ties back on track of improvement; leaders' meeting expected in Shenzhen next week
title.zh_hans: 王毅晤韩外长赵显：中韩关系重回改善轨道　期待下周深圳APEC领袖会晤

summary.zh_hant: 中共中央政治局委員、外長王毅在北京與韓國外長趙顯舉行會談。王毅表示，中韓關係已重回改善發展軌道，中方願同韓方攜手努力，繼續保持高層交往。趙顯表示，朝鮮半島問題關乎韓國切身利益，半島和平與穩定符合韓中兩國共同利益，韓方願同中方繼續加強戰略溝通，推動半島局勢取得積極進展。兩人均期待兩國領導人下星期在深圳出席亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議期間會晤。
summary.en: Wang Yi, a member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun. Wang said China-South Korea relations have returned to a track of improvement and development, and China is willing to work with South Korea to maintain high-level exchanges. Cho said the Korean Peninsula issue concerns South Korea's vital interests and that peace and stability on the peninsula serve the common interests of both countries; South Korea is willing to continue strengthening strategic communication with China to achieve positive progress on the peninsula situation. Both looked forward to the two countries' leaders meeting next week in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央政治局委员、外长王毅在北京与韩国外长赵显举行会谈。王毅表示，中韩关系已重回改善发展轨道，中方愿同韩方携手努力，继续保持高层交往。赵显表示，朝鲜半岛问题关乎韩国切身利益，半岛和平与稳定符合韩中两国共同利益，韩方愿同中方继续加强战略沟通，推动半岛局势取得积极进展。两人均期待两国领导人下星期在深圳出席亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议期间会晤。

title.zh_hant: 微軟大規模死機　證監會已聯絡持牌機構評估影響　港交所確認市場有序運作
title.en: Microsoft outage: SFC has contacted licensed firms to assess business impact; HKEX confirms markets operating in an orderly manner
title.zh_hans: 微软大规模死机　证监会已联络持牌机构评估影响　港交所确认市场有序运作

summary.zh_hant: 證監會表示，正密切注視微軟服務大規模中斷引發的情況，並已聯絡持牌機構及市場參與者，評估對業務運作的影響。證監會將繼續評估有關狀況，根據需要採取適當行動。證監會強調，基本職能繼續正常運作，網上服務及市場監察等運作均保持正常；不過，鑑於微軟服務大規模中斷，部分通訊可能受到影響。證監會又說，港交所已確認，香港市場有序運作。
summary.en: The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) said it is closely monitoring the situation arising from the large-scale disruption to Microsoft services and has contacted licensed corporations and market participants to assess the impact on their business operations. The SFC will continue to assess the situation and take appropriate action as needed. The SFC stressed that its basic functions continue to operate normally, with online services and market surveillance operating normally; however, given the large-scale disruption to Microsoft services, some communications may be affected. The SFC added that Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has confirmed the Hong Kong market is operating in an orderly manner.
summary.zh_hans: 证监会表示，正密切注视微软服务大规模中断引发的情况，并已联络持牌机构及市场参与者，评估对业务运作的影响。证监会将继续评估有关状况，根据需要采取适当行动。证监会强调，基本职能继续正常运作，网上服务及市场监察等运作均保持正常；不过，鉴于微软服务大规模中断，部分通讯可能受到影响。证监会又说，港交所已确认，香港市场有序运作。

title.zh_hant: 14個月大女嬰染甲流不治　今年第3宗兒童流感死亡　今季29宗重症
title.en: 14-month-old girl dies of influenza A, third fatal paediatric flu case this year; 29 severe cases this season
title.zh_hans: 14个月大女婴染甲流不治　今年第3宗儿童流感死亡　今季29宗重症

summary.zh_hant: 衞生署衞生防護中心宣布，一名14個月大女嬰感染甲型流感，今日（11月13日）不治。衞生防護中心早於10月29日公布該個案為兒童甲型流感嚴重個案，這是本港今年第三宗兒童流感死亡個案。本港自今年6月底進入流感季節至今已超過4個月，最新監測數據顯示整體流感活躍程度有所回落，但仍高於基線水平；今個流感季節累計錄得29宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中22人已康復出院、2人情況穩定、2人危殆、3人不治。衞生防護中心總監徐樂堅提醒市民，本港仍處於流感季節，呼籲所有6個月或以上、沒有已知禁忌症的人士盡快接種季節性流感疫苗；上年度數據顯示，未接種疫苗的兒童感染流感後出現嚴重併發症或死亡的比率，約為已接種兒童的5倍。今年的季節性流感疫苗計劃已推行約兩個月，公私營界別疫苗供應充足，合資格人士可於全港約270個公營服務點接種，包括衞生署約110間指定診所（其中29間母嬰健康院為6個月至未滿2歲兒童接種）、醫管局76間家庭醫學診所及38間公立醫院，以及基層醫療署45個地區康健中心及服務點；另有逾1,900名私家醫生參與疫苗資助計劃，於全港逾3,200個服務點提供接種。兒童患流感後病情可迅速惡化，家長須密切留意，如出現氣促、喘鳴、嘴唇發紫、胸痛、神志不清、持續發燒或抽搐等徵狀，應立即帶同子女到急症室求醫。
summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of the Department of Health announced that a 14-month-old girl infected with influenza A passed away today (November 13). The CHP had announced the case as a severe case of influenza A infection on October 29; this is the third fatal case of paediatric influenza infection in Hong Kong this year. Hong Kong entered the influenza season in late June, and the season has lasted for more than four months; the latest surveillance data showed overall influenza activity has declined but remains above baseline levels. A cumulative total of 29 cases of severe paediatric influenza infection have been recorded in the current influenza season, of whom 22 have recovered and been discharged, two are in stable condition, two are in critical condition, and three have passed away. The Controller of the CHP, Dr Edwin Tsui, reminded the public that Hong Kong is still in the midst of the influenza season and urged everyone aged six months or older, except those with known contraindications, to receive the seasonal influenza vaccination promptly if they have not yet done so; data from the previous year showed the rate of severe complications or death among unvaccinated children following influenza infection was about five times higher than among vaccinated children. This year's seasonal influenza vaccination programmes have been underway for about two months, with an adequate supply of vaccines in both the public and private healthcare sectors; eligible persons may receive the vaccine at about 270 public service points, including around 110 designated clinics under the Department of Health (including all 29 Maternal and Child Health Centres for children aged six months to under two years), 76 Family Medicine Clinics and 38 public hospitals under the Hospital Authority, and 45 District Health Centres and service points under the Primary Healthcare Commission; over 1,900 private doctors also participate in the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme at over 3,200 service points across Hong Kong. A child's condition can deteriorate rapidly with influenza; parents must pay close attention and visit an accident and emergency department immediately if the child's condition deteriorates with symptoms such as shortness of breath, wheezing, blue lips, chest pain, confusion, a persistent fever or convulsions.
summary.zh_hans: 卫生署卫生防护中心宣布，一名14个月大女婴感染甲型流感，今日（11月13日）不治。卫生防护中心早于10月29日公布该个案为儿童甲型流感严重个案，这是本港今年第三宗儿童流感死亡个案。本港自今年6月底进入流感季节至今已超过4个月，最新监测数据显示整体流感活跃程度有所回落，但仍高于基线水平；今个流感季节累计录得29宗儿童流感严重个案，其中22人已康复出院、2人情况稳定、2人危殆、3人不治。卫生防护中心总监徐乐坚提醒市民，本港仍处于流感季节，呼吁所有6个月或以上、没有已知禁忌症的人士尽快接种季节性流感疫苗；上年度数据显示，未接种疫苗的儿童感染流感后出现严重并发症或死亡的比率，约为已接种儿童的5倍。今年的季节性流感疫苗计划已推行约两个月，公私营界别疫苗供应充足，合资格人士可于全港约270个公营服务点接种，包括卫生署约110间指定诊所（其中29间母婴健康院为6个月至未满2岁儿童接种）、医管局76间家庭医学诊所及38间公立医院，以及基层医疗署45个地区康健中心及服务点；另有逾1,900名私家医生参与疫苗资助计划，于全港逾3,200个服务点提供接种。儿童患流感后病情可迅速恶化，家长须密切留意，如出现气促、喘鸣、嘴唇发紫、胸痛、神志不清、持续发烧或抽搐等征状，应立即带同子女到急症室求医。

title.zh_hant: 香港海運週十周年　下周日開鑼　逾1.8萬人聚首　60場活動撐國際航運中心
title.en: Hong Kong Maritime Week marks 10th anniversary: over 18,000 to gather from Sunday for 60 events backing the city's maritime hub status
title.zh_hans: 香港海运周十周年　下周日开锣　逾1.8万人聚首　60场活动撑国际航运中心

summary.zh_hant: 第十屆香港海運週將於11月15日（星期日）至21日一連七日舉行，預計吸引逾18,000名來自世界各地的政策制定者、主要國際航運組織領袖、商界決策者、專家及業界精英參與，包括「一帶一路」國家的高級政府官員。運輸及物流局將在海運週期間公布多項重要的海運相關成果；國家「十五五」規劃綱要明確支持香港鞏固和提升國際航運中心及國際航空樞紐雙樞紐地位，而特區政府今年9月公布的《香港第一個五年規劃》亦主動對接國家「十五五」規劃的戰略方向，訂出未來五年海事及航空等範疇的目標。香港海運週首辦於2016年，現已發展成為海事、港口及物流界首屈一指的國際盛事；當局將在今屆十周年之際公布新一批夥伴港口，並簽署多份海運相關合作備忘錄。今屆海運週由特區政府統籌、香港海運港口發展局主辦，香港船東會及香港海事博物館協辦，香港貿易發展局及投資推廣署為合作夥伴；逾80個本地、內地及海外海事組織合辦逾60項活動，涵蓋旗艦論壇、高層研討會、業界展覽及商務交流。重點活動包括下星期一（11月16日）舉行的海運週開幕典禮及世界航商大會、下星期一至二舉行的亞洲物流航運及空運會議2026，以及下星期二舉行的第二屆香港海運港口發展局旗艦峰會；其他重點活動包括第三屆國際航運公會香港全球海運貿易峰會及國際燃油工業協會香港替代船用燃料論壇，波羅的海國際航運公會亦首次參與海運週，與國際調解院合辦綠色航運合約發展專題研討會。運輸及物流局與無綫電視合作製作10集宣傳劇集《乘風啟航》，將於11月16日至27日逢星期一至五在三個無綫頻道（包括81、82及83台）播出，以戲劇元素介紹海事職業實況及行業創新發展。此外，海運港口發展局與香港海事博物館合辦「Project Art Container」展覽，「一容器一故事」繪畫比賽優勝作品已製成20呎藝術貨櫃裝置，將於11月15日至25日在香港海事博物館中庭展出，其後沿國際航線啟航；海事主題嘉年華則於11月21日及22日舉行。
summary.en: Hong Kong Maritime Week (HKMW) 2026, a flagship annual maritime event anticipated worldwide, will be held for seven consecutive days from Sunday (November 15) to November 21, expected to attract over 18,000 policymakers, leaders of major international shipping organisations, business decision-makers, experts and industry elites from around the globe, including high-ranking government officials from Belt and Road countries. The Transport and Logistics Bureau (TLB) will announce several important maritime-related deliverables during the week; the National 15th Five-Year Plan Outline indicates clear support for Hong Kong in consolidating and enhancing its dual-hub status as an international maritime centre and an international aviation hub, and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government's First Five-Year Plan, announced in September this year, proactively aligns with the strategic direction of the National 15th Five-Year Plan, setting out the Government's targets in areas such as maritime and aviation over the next five years. First held in 2016, HKMW has evolved over the years into a premier international event for the maritime, port and logistics sectors; the Government will announce the new batch of partner ports and sign a number of maritime-related memoranda of understanding at this significant 10th-anniversary milestone. This year's HKMW is co-ordinated by the HKSAR Government, organised by the Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board (HKMPDB), and co-organised by the Hong Kong Shipowners Association and the Hong Kong Maritime Museum (HKMM), with the Hong Kong Trade Development Council and Invest Hong Kong as partners; over 60 events are jointly hosted by more than 80 local, Chinese Mainland and overseas maritime organisations, covering flagship forums, high-level seminars, industry exhibitions and business networking. Key highlights include the Opening Ceremony of HKMW 2026 and World Maritime Merchants Forum next Monday (November 16), the Asian Logistics, Maritime and Aviation Conference 2026 next Monday to Tuesday (November 16 to 17), and the 2nd HKMPDB Flagship Summit next Tuesday (November 17); other signature events include the 3rd International Chamber of Shipping Hong Kong Global Maritime Trade Summit and the International Bunker Industry Association Hong Kong Forum on Alternative Marine Fuels, while the Baltic and International Maritime Council will participate in HKMW for the first time, collaborating with the International Organization for Mediation to host a thematic seminar on contractual developments for green shipping. To heighten public awareness of Hong Kong's maritime development, the TLB has partnered with Television Broadcasts Limited (TVB) to produce a 10-episode promotional drama series titled "Navigating to the Future", to be broadcast from November 16 to 27, every Monday to Friday, across three TVB channels (including Channels 81, 82 and 83). A rich array of community and youth engagement programmes will also be rolled out, headlined by the "Project Art Container" exhibition organised by the HKMPDB in partnership with the HKMM, with winning artworks from the "One Container One Story" drawing competition turned into 20-foot art container installations, to be showcased at the HKMM Jockey Club Anchor Plaza between November 15 and 25 before setting sail across international shipping routes; a maritime-themed carnival will take place on November 21 and 22.
summary.zh_hans: 第十届香港海运周将于11月15日（星期日）至21日一连七日举行，预计吸引逾18,000名来自世界各地的政策制定者、主要国际航运组织领袖、商界决策者、专家及业界精英参与，包括「一带一路」国家的高级政府官员。运输及物流局将在海运周期间公布多项重要的海运相关成果；国家「十五五」规划纲要明确支持香港巩固和提升国际航运中心及国际航空枢纽双枢纽地位，而特区政府今年9月公布的《香港第一个五年规划》亦主动对接国家「十五五」规划的战略方向，订出未来五年海事及航空等范畴的目标。香港海运周首办于2016年，现已发展成为海事、港口及物流界首屈一指的国际盛事；当局将在今届十周年之际公布新一批伙伴港口，并签署多份海运相关合作备忘录。今届海运周由特区政府统筹、香港海运港口发展局主办，香港船东会及香港海事博物馆协办，香港贸易发展局及投资推广署为合作伙伴；逾80个本地、内地及海外海事组织合办逾60项活动，涵盖旗舰论坛、高层研讨会、业界展览及商务交流。重点活动包括下星期一（11月16日）举行的海运周开幕典礼及世界航商大会、下星期一至二举行的亚洲物流航运及空运会议2026，以及下星期二举行的第二届香港海运港口发展局旗舰峰会；其他重点活动包括第三届国际航运公会香港全球海运贸易峰会及国际燃油工业协会香港替代船用燃料论坛，波罗的海国际航运公会亦首次参与海运周，与国际调解院合办绿色航运合约发展专题研讨会。运输及物流局与无线电视合作制作10集宣传剧集《乘风启航》，将于11月16日至27日逢星期一至五在三个无线频道（包括81、82及83台）播出，以戏剧元素介绍海事职业实况及行业创新发展。此外，海运港口发展局与香港海事博物馆合办「Project Art Container」展览，「一容器一故事」绘画比赛优胜作品已制成20呎艺术货柜装置，将于11月15日至25日在香港海事博物馆中庭展出，其后沿国际航线启航；海事主题嘉年华则于11月21日及22日举行。

title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：保險業要增強自身強韌性　應對不明朗環境
title.en: Paul Chan: insurance industry must strengthen its own resilience amid uncertainty
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：保险业要增强自身强韧性　应对不明朗环境

summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，在充滿不確定性的環境中，保險業需要增強自身的強韌性。國家金融監督管理總局副局長叢林表示，近年內地的保險業高質量發展取得明顯進展，國家願與各地推進區域保險交流合作。
summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that in an environment full of uncertainties, the insurance industry needs to strengthen its own resilience. Cong Lin, Deputy Director of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, said the high-quality development of the Mainland's insurance industry has made notable progress in recent years, and the country is willing to advance regional insurance exchanges and co-operation with various places.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波表示，在充满不确定性的环境中，保险业需要增强自身的强韧性。国家金融监督管理总局副局长丛林表示，近年内地的保险业高质量发展取得明显进展，国家愿与各地推进区域保险交流合作。

title.zh_hant: 34歲男輸入猴痘確診　情況穩定　本港累計120宗　衞生防護中心籲高危群組打針
title.en: Imported Mpox case confirmed in 34-year-old man, condition stable; Hong Kong total reaches 120 as health officials urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated
title.zh_hans: 34岁男输入猴痘确诊　情况稳定　本港累计120宗　卫生防护中心吁高危群组打针

summary.zh_hant: 衞生署衞生防護中心正調查一宗輸入猴痘個案，強烈呼籲高風險目標群組接種猴痘疫苗。個案涉及一名34歲男子，他於11月9日出現發燒、疲倦及手臂出疹，皮疹其後擴散至身體多處，包括生殖器、腹部及胸部；11月11日到伊利沙伯醫院急症室求診並入院隔離治療，現時情況穩定，衞生防護中心公共衞生化驗服務處化驗證實其臨床樣本對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。病人表示在潛伏期內曾在香港以外與其他男性有高風險性接觸，流行病學調查仍在進行中，個案將向世界衞生組織報告。自2022年以來，本港共錄得120宗猴痘個案（94宗本地、26宗輸入），全部患者為男性；自8月以來錄得的27宗個案，全部患者在潛伏期內曾進行高風險性行為，包括與男性陌生人或多名伴侶發生性行為及無使用安全套，大部分未接種猴痘疫苗。自8月以來的本地個案患者多使用特定約會應用程式尋找臨時男性性伴侶，部分人在確診後無法聯絡新認識的性伴侶，影響追蹤工作；衞生防護中心已加強社交媒體宣傳，並與相關約會應用程式營運商合作，定期向香港所有用戶推送猴痘預防及接種資訊。研究顯示接種兩劑猴痘疫苗可減低感染風險82%，本地數據顯示已接種患者出現病毒擴散至身體其他部位的機會低87%。自9月底起，衞生防護中心除常規接種場地外，另於衞生防護中心大樓增設猴痘疫苗接種中心，並與非政府機構合作提供外展接種服務；自9月28日以來，逾1,000名高風險人士已在常規及新增接種場地接種猴痘疫苗。猴痘熱線2125 2373繼續為高風險人士提供健康評估及建議，每日上午9時至下午6時運作。猴痘一般不會經呼吸道飛沫或氣溶膠傳播，也不會經社交接觸傳播；相關病徵包括皮疹、發燒、發冷、淋巴結腫大、疲倦、肌肉疼痛及嚴重頭痛。
summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) of the Department of Health is investigating an imported Mpox case and strongly urged high-risk target groups to receive Mpox vaccinations. The case involves a 34-year-old man who developed a fever, fatigue and a rash on his arms on November 9; the rash subsequently spread to various parts of his body, including his genital area, abdomen and chest. He attended the Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital on November 11 and was admitted for isolation treatment; he is currently in stable condition, and laboratory testing by the CHP's Public Health Laboratory Services Branch confirmed his clinical specimen tested positive for the Monkeypox virus. According to information provided by the patient, he had high-risk sexual contact with other men outside Hong Kong during the incubation period; the epidemiological investigation is continuing, and the case will be reported to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 120 Mpox cases (94 local cases and 26 imported cases), all patients male; among the 27 cases recorded since August, all patients reported having engaged in high-risk sexual activities during the incubation period, including having sex with male strangers or multiple partners and having sex without a condom, and most of them have not received Mpox vaccination. Among the local cases recorded since August, patients commonly used specific dating apps to find casual male sexual partners, and after testing positive some patients were unable to contact their newly met sexual partners, which hindered the CHP's ability to conduct effective contact tracing; the CHP has increased its outreach on social media platforms to promote Mpox prevention and vaccination and has collaborated with the operators of relevant dating apps to regularly push information on Mpox prevention and vaccination to all users in Hong Kong. Studies show that receiving two doses of the Mpox vaccine reduces the risk of infection by 82 per cent, and local data show vaccinated patients are 87 per cent less likely to experience viral spread to other parts of the body. Since late September, the CHP has set up an additional Mpox vaccination centre at the CHP Building in addition to regular vaccination venues, and has collaborated with relevant non-governmental organisations to provide outreach vaccination services; since September 28, over 1,000 high-risk individuals have received the Mpox vaccine at the regular and additional vaccination venues. The CHP's Mpox hotline (2125 2373) continues to provide health assessments and advice to high-risk individuals, operating daily from 9am to 6pm. Mpox is not transmitted through respiratory droplets or aerosols in general, and transmission would not occur through social contact; relevant symptoms include rash, fever, chills, swollen lymph nodes, exhaustion, muscle pain and severe headaches.
summary.zh_hans: 卫生署卫生防护中心正调查一宗输入猴痘个案，强烈呼吁高风险目标群组接种猴痘疫苗。个案涉及一名34岁男子，他于11月9日出现发烧、疲倦及手臂出疹，皮疹其后扩散至身体多处，包括生殖器、腹部及胸部；11月11日到伊利沙伯医院急症室求诊并入院隔离治疗，现时情况稳定，卫生防护中心公共卫生化验服务处化验确认其临床样本对猴痘病毒呈阳性反应。病人表示在潜伏期内曾在香港以外与其他男性有高风险性接触，流行病学调查仍在进行中，个案将向世界卫生组织报告。自2022年以来，本港共录得120宗猴痘个案（94宗本地、26宗输入），全部患者为男性；自8月以来录得的27宗个案，全部患者在潜伏期内曾进行高风险性行为，包括与男性陌生人或多名伴侣发生性行为及无使用安全套，大部分未接种猴痘疫苗。自8月以来的本地个案患者多使用特定约会应用程式寻找临时男性性伴侣，部分人在确诊后无法联络新认识的性伴侣，影响追踪工作；卫生防护中心已加强社交媒体宣传，并与相关约会应用程式营运商合作，定期向香港所有用户推送猴痘预防及接种信息。研究显示接种两剂猴痘疫苗可减低感染风险82%，本地数据显示已接种患者出现病毒扩散至身体其他部位的机会低87%。自9月底起，卫生防护中心除常规接种场地外，另于卫生防护中心大楼增设猴痘疫苗接种中心，并与非政府机构合作提供外展接种服务；自9月28日以来，逾1,000名高风险人士已在常规及新增接种场地接种猴痘疫苗。猴痘热线2125 2373继续为高风险人士提供健康评估及建议，每日上午9时至下午6时运作。猴痘一般不会经呼吸道飞沫或气溶胶传播，也不会经社交接触传播；相关病征包括皮疹、发烧、发冷、淋巴结肿大、疲倦、肌肉疼痛及严重头痛。

title.zh_hant: 米埔兩環境樣本驗出H5禽流感　漁護署加強監察　3公里內無雞場
title.en: Two environmental samples from Mai Po test positive for H5 bird flu; AFCD steps up monitoring, no chicken farms within 3 km
title.zh_hans: 米埔两环境样本验出H5禽流感　渔护署加强监察　3公里内无鸡场

summary.zh_hant: 漁農自然護理署表示，香港大學公共衞生學院研究團隊與漁護署合作，定期在米埔自然護理區採集樣本作禽流感監測；11月11日採集的兩個環境樣本證實對H5高致病性禽流感病毒呈陽性，港大於11月12日通知漁護署。協助管理米埔的世界自然基金會香港分會已加強清潔消毒遊客設施，包括觀鳥屋及浮橋，並在入口放置消毒墊供遊客消毒鞋底；漁護署正密切監察米埔雀鳥情況，並張貼告示提醒遊客注意個人衞生。樣本採集地點3公里內沒有雞場；漁護署已加強禽流感監測，密切監察本地雞場及批發市場情況。市民應避免接觸野鳥及活家禽及其糞便，接觸後徹底洗手；如發現疑似患病或死亡雀鳥，可致電1823通知漁護署跟進。
summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said two environmental samples collected at the Mai Po Nature Reserve on November 11 have tested positive for the H5 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus. The samples were collected under regular avian influenza surveillance by a research team of the University of Hong Kong's School of Public Health in collaboration with the department, and HKU notified the department on November 12. The World Wide Fund for Nature Hong Kong, which assists in managing the reserve, has stepped up cleaning and disinfection of visitor facilities, including bird hides and the floating boardwalk, and placed disinfection mats at the entrance for visitors to disinfect the soles of their shoes; the department is closely monitoring the birds in the reserve and has put up notices reminding visitors about personal hygiene. There are no chicken farms within three kilometres of where the samples were collected, and the department has strengthened avian influenza surveillance, closely monitoring local poultry farms and the wholesale market. Members of the public should avoid contact with wild birds and live poultry and their droppings, wash their hands thoroughly after contact, and call 1823 if they come across suspected sick or dead birds.
summary.zh_hans: 渔农自然护理署表示，香港大学公共卫生学院研究团队与渔护署合作，定期在米埔自然护理区采集样本作禽流感监测；11月11日采集的两个环境样本证实对H5高致病性禽流感病毒呈阳性，港大于11月12日通知渔护署。协助管理米埔的世界自然基金会香港分会已加强清洁消毒游客设施，包括观鸟屋及浮桥，并在入口放置消毒垫供游客消毒鞋底；渔护署正密切监察米埔雀鸟情况，并张贴告示提醒游客注意个人卫生。样本采集地点3公里内没有鸡场；渔护署已加强禽流感监测，密切监察本地鸡场及批发市场情况。市民应避免接触野鸟及活家禽及其粪便，接触后彻底洗手；如发现疑似患病或死亡雀鸟，可致电1823通知渔护署跟进。

title.zh_hant: 假網站冒充銀行同業結算　呃FPS用戶交銀行資料　官方籲認清真網址
title.en: Fake websites impersonate interbank clearing firm to steal FPS users' bank details; public urged to check the real web addresses
title.zh_hans: 假网站冒充银行同业结算　呃FPS用户交银行资料　官方吁认清真网址

summary.zh_hant: 香港銀行同業結算有限公司提醒市民，有兩個欺詐網站冒充與該公司有關，分別是tk.f2g4h.cn及fps.852789.cc，該公司與有關欺詐網站並無任何關連。該等網站假冒「買家網上保障」，提供買家退款、未經授權網上交易舉報及網上交易支援等服務，並誘使市民提供銀行名稱、銀行帳戶號碼及帳戶持有人姓名，以便在平台虛擬錢包增值及提款，更會引導市民聯絡假冒的客戶服務人員。結算公司強調不會直接向個別市民提供轉數快服務，一般情況下亦不會主動聯絡個別市民；真正的官方網站是www.hkicl.com.hk及fps.hkicl.com.hk。市民如收到可疑通訊，可致電2533 1111核實；懷疑受騙應盡快向警方舉報。
summary.en: Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (HKICL) has warned the public about two fraudulent websites purporting to be associated with the company, tk.f2g4h.cn and fps.852789.cc, which have no affiliation with HKICL or any of its businesses. The websites impersonate a "Buyer Online Protection" service for Faster Payment System (FPS) transactions, offering buyer refunds, reporting of unauthorised online transactions and online transaction support, and trick users into providing their bank name, bank account number and account holder's name to top up and withdraw money from the platforms' virtual wallets, even directing them to fraudsters impersonating customer service staff. HKICL stressed that it does not provide FPS services directly to individual members of the public and would not proactively contact them under usual circumstances; its genuine official websites are www.hkicl.com.hk and fps.hkicl.com.hk. Members of the public who receive suspicious communications should call 2533 1111 to verify, and those who suspect they have been defrauded should report to the Police promptly.
summary.zh_hans: 香港银行同业结算有限公司提醒市民，有两个欺诈网站冒充与该公司有关，分别是tk.f2g4h.cn及fps.852789.cc，该公司与有关欺诈网站并无任何关连。该等网站假冒「买家网上保障」，提供买家退款、未经授权网上交易举报及网上交易支援等服务，并诱使市民提供银行名称、银行账户号码及账户持有人姓名，以便在平台虚拟钱包增值及提款，更会引导市民联络假冒的客户服务人员。结算公司强调不会直接向个别市民提供转数快服务，一般情况下亦不会主动联络个别市民；真正的官方网站是www.hkicl.com.hk及fps.hkicl.com.hk。市民如收到可疑通讯，可致电2533 1111核实；怀疑受骗应尽快向警方举报。

title.zh_hant: 漁護署明日起突擊查狗主　大狗唔用短繩牽引最高罰2.5萬囚3個月
title.en: AFCD to blitz dog owners from tomorrow: large dogs without a short leash face fines up to $25,000 and three months' jail
title.zh_hans: 渔护署明日起突击查狗主　大狗唔用短绳牵引最高罚2.5万囚3个月

summary.zh_hant: 漁農自然護理署宣布，為提高狗主在公眾地方妥善控制狗隻的意識，並減少因不當控制狗隻而引致的狗隻襲擊事件，將於11月14日及21日在全港狗隻出沒地點進行特別巡查及執法行動。行動期間，漁護署人員會加強在狗隻聚集的公眾地方巡查及執法，如發現狗主未有按法例要求妥善控制狗隻，會即時採取執法行動，不會預先警告，同時藉機會推廣負責任寵物主人的訊息。根據《狂犬病條例》，狗隻在公眾地方時必須以狗帶牽引或以其他有效方式控制，違例者最高可被判罰款1萬元；《危險狗隻規例》更明確規定，體重達20公斤或以上的大型狗隻在公眾地方時，必須由人以一條長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥牽引，違例者可被判罰款25,000元及監禁3個月。所有超過5個月大的狗隻必須植入晶片、接種狂犬病疫苗及領有牌照，其後每隔不超過3年再次接種疫苗及續牌。
summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department announced special inspection and enforcement operations at locations across Hong Kong on November 14 and 21, to raise awareness among dog keepers of the need to properly control their dogs in public places and reduce dog attacks arising from improper control. During the operations, department officers will step up inspections and enforcement at public places where dogs congregate; keepers found not to have properly controlled their dogs as required by law will face immediate enforcement action without prior warning, and officers will use the opportunity to promote responsible pet ownership. Under the Rabies Ordinance, dogs in a public place must be held on a leash or otherwise effectively controlled, with offenders liable to a maximum fine of $10,000; the Dangerous Dogs Regulation states explicitly that large dogs weighing 20 kilograms or above must be securely held on a leash not exceeding two metres in length by a person in a public place, with offenders liable to a fine of $25,000 and imprisonment for three months. All dogs over five months old must be microchipped, vaccinated against rabies and licensed, with re-vaccination and licence renewal at intervals of no more than three years.
summary.zh_hans: 渔农自然护理署宣布，为提高狗主在公众地方妥善控制狗只的意识，并减少因不当控制狗只而引致的狗只袭击事件，将于11月14日及21日在全港狗只出没地点进行特别巡查及执法行动。行动期间，渔护署人员会加强在狗只聚集的公众地方巡查及执法，如发现狗主未有按法例要求妥善控制狗只，会即时采取执法行动，不会预先警告，同时借机会推广负责任宠物主人的讯息。根据《狂犬病条例》，狗只在公众地方时必须以狗带牵引或以其他有效方式控制，违例者最高可被判罚款1万元；《危险狗只规例》更明确规定，体重达20公斤或以上的大型狗只在公众地方时，必须由人以一条长度不超逾两米的狗带稳妥牵引，违例者可被判罚款25,000元及监禁3个月。所有超过5个月大的狗只必须植入芯片、接种狂犬病疫苗及领有牌照，其后每隔不超过3年再次接种疫苗及续牌。

title.zh_hant: 港交所下月推數碼支付新方案　用數碼港元繳收市後按金　24小時運作
title.en: HKEX to launch digital payment solution next month, letting traders settle after-hours margin with e-HKD around the clock
title.zh_hans: 港交所下月推数码支付新方案　用数码港元缴收市后按金　24小时运作

summary.zh_hant: 香港交易所公布，將於12月14日推出新的數碼支付方案，便利結算參與者在衍生產品市場收市後交易時段支付預繳按金。新服務建基於港交所6月與金管局探索使用數碼港元的合作計劃，採用24/7運作模式的批發層面央行數碼貨幣，支付收市後交易時段的預繳按金。新方案推出後，合資格期貨結算公司結算參與者可選用這個數碼支付方式，於下午5時至凌晨1時30分提交預繳按金申請，以便款項用於相應的收市後交易時段。延長後的支付時段將作為現有支付安排的補充，讓結算參與者可於一般銀行營業時間以外，更靈活管理以資本額釐定的持倉限額使用情況。港交所已與金管局、交收銀行及結算參與者試行真實交易，驗證技術及營運安排已準備就緒。這項靈活的支付方式將配合港交所計劃於明年3月起延長衍生產品市場收市後交易時段的安排。
summary.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing announced it will launch a new digital payment solution on December 14, making it easier for clearing participants to pay margin during the derivatives market's after-hours trading session. The service builds on a June collaboration between HKEX and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority exploring the use of the e-HKD, using a 24/7 wholesale central bank digital currency to pay margin for the after-hours session. After launch, eligible clearing participants of futures clearing houses may opt for this digital payment method to submit margin payment applications between 5pm and 1.30am, so funds can be used in the corresponding after-hours session. The extended payment window will supplement existing arrangements, letting participants manage their capital-based position limit usage more flexibly outside normal banking hours. HKEX has trialled live transactions with the HKMA, settlement banks and clearing participants to verify the technology and operational arrangements are ready. The flexible payment method will complement HKEX's plan to extend the derivatives market's after-hours trading session from March next year.
summary.zh_hans: 香港交易所公布，将于12月14日推出新的数码支付方案，便利结算参与者在衍生产品市场收市后交易时段支付预缴按金。新服务建基于港交所6月与金管局探索使用数码港元的合作计划，采用24/7运作模式的批发层面央行数字货币，支付收市后交易时段的预缴按金。新方案推出后，合资格期货结算公司结算参与者可选用这个数码支付方式，于下午5时至凌晨1时30分提交预缴按金申请，以便款项用于相应的收市后交易时段。延长后的支付时段将作为现有支付安排的补充，让结算参与者可于一般银行营业时间以外，更灵活管理以资本额厘定的持仓限额使用情况。港交所已与金管局、交收银行及结算参与者试行真实交易，验证技术及营运安排已准备就绪。这项灵活的支付方式将配合港交所计划于明年3月起延长衍生产品市场收市后交易时段的安排。

title.zh_hant: APEC深圳峰會將至　港設臨時限飛區　無人機直升機11月17至20日禁飛
title.en: Ahead of APEC summit in Shenzhen, Hong Kong sets temporary no-fly zones: drones and helicopters grounded November 17-20
title.zh_hans: APEC深圳峰会将至　港设临时限飞区　无人机直升机11月17至20日禁飞

summary.zh_hant: 警方及民航處今日提醒市民，因應第33屆亞太經合組織經濟領袖會議在深圳舉行，香港將於11月17日凌晨零時01分至11月20日晚上11時59分設立臨時限制飛行區。A區（新界北）除特別許可外，禁止無人機、滑翔傘、飛艇、風箏、繫留氣球及大量放氣球；B區（全港）除政府飛行服務隊外，禁止所有直升機及輕型飛機進行任何飛行活動。民航處已透過航空資料刊物補充資料向航空公司及機師公布有關安排，並已將小型無人機的限制飛行區資料上載至小型無人機電子平台「eSUA」。警方及民航處提醒市民，未經特別許可在限制飛行區內進行飛行活動即屬違法，一經定罪可被罰款及監禁，呼籲市民切勿以身試法。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Civil Aviation Department today reminded the public that, in connection with the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting to be held in Shenzhen, temporary restricted flying zones will be established in Hong Kong from 12.01am on November 17 to 11.59pm on November 20. In Zone A (New Territories North), unmanned aircraft (except with special permission), paragliding, airships, kites, captive balloons and mass release of balloons are prohibited; in Zone B (territory-wide), all helicopters and light aircraft are prohibited from any flying activities, except for the Government Flying Service. The Civil Aviation Department has promulgated the arrangements to airlines and pilots via an Aeronautical Information Publication Supplement and uploaded the small unmanned aircraft restricted flying zone details to the "eSUA" electronic portal. The Police and the department reminded the public that conducting flying activities within the restricted flying zones without special permission is an offence, liable on conviction to a fine and imprisonment, and urged the public not to defy the law.
summary.zh_hans: 警方及民航处今日提醒市民，因应第33届亚太经合组织经济领袖会议在深圳举行，香港将于11月17日凌晨零时01分至11月20日晚上11时59分设立临时限制飞行区。A区（新界北）除特别许可外，禁止无人机、滑翔伞、飞艇、风筝、系留气球及大量放气球；B区（全港）除政府飞行服务队外，禁止所有直升机及轻型飞机进行任何飞行活动。民航处已透过航空资料刊物补充资料向航空公司及机师公布有关安排，并已将小型无人机的限制飞行区资料上载至小型无人机电子平台「eSUA」。警方及民航处提醒市民，未经特别许可在限制飞行区内进行飞行活动即属违法，一经定罪可被罚款及监禁，呼吁市民切勿以身试法。

title.zh_hant: 沙田石門地皮下周五招標　8015平方米　12月18日截標
title.en: Sha Tin site in Shek Mun goes to tender next Friday: 8,015 sq m lot, bids close December 18
title.zh_hans: 沙田石门地皮下周五招标　8015平方米　12月18日截标

summary.zh_hant: 地政總署宣布，列入2026-27年度賣地計劃的沙田地段第626號用地，將以公開招標方式出售，招標期為11月20日至12月18日。該地皮位於沙田石門大涌橋路與安睦街交界，面積約8,015平方米，指定作非工業用途（貨倉、酒店及加油站除外），最低及最高樓面面積分別為29,816平方米及49,693平方米。招標文件包括投標表格、招標公告、賣地條件及賣地圖，可於11月20日起在地政總署網站下載，賣地圖亦可於同日起供市民查閱，印刷本可於北角政府合署6樓地政總署測繪處購買；招標詳情將於11月20日刊憲。
summary.en: The Lands Department announced that Sha Tin Town Lot No. 626, listed in the 2026-27 Land Sale List, will be disposed of by public tender, with the tender invitation running from November 20 to December 18. The lot, at the junction of Tai Chung Kiu Road and On Sum Street in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, has a site area of about 8,015 square metres and is designated for non-industrial purposes (excluding godown, hotel and petrol filling station), with a minimum gross floor area of 29,816 square metres and a maximum of 49,693 square metres. Land sale documents, including the form of tender, tender notice, conditions of sale and sale plan, will be available for download from the Lands Department's website from November 20, and the sale plan will be available for public inspection from the same day; hard copies may be purchased at the Survey and Mapping Office on the 6th floor of North Point Government Offices. The particulars of the tender will be gazetted on November 20.
summary.zh_hans: 地政总署宣布，列入2026-27年度卖地计划的沙田地段第626号用地，将以公开招标方式出售，招标期为11月20日至12月18日。该地皮位于沙田石门大涌桥路与安睦街交界，面积约8,015平方米，指定作非工业用途（货仓、酒店及加油站除外），最低及最高楼面面积分别为29,816平方米及49,693平方米。招标文件包括投标表格、招标公告、卖地条件及卖地图，可于11月20日起在地政总署网站下载，卖地图亦可于同日起供市民查阅，印刷本可于北角政府合署6楼地政总署测绘处购买；招标详情将于11月20日刊宪。

title.zh_hant: AI產品佔本港出口約75%　政府經濟顧問：出口續強勁　留意投資波動
title.en: AI products make up about 75% of Hong Kong's exports, government economist says; exports to stay strong, investment swings watched
title.zh_hans: AI产品占本港出口约75%　政府经济顾问：出口续强劲　留意投资波动

summary.zh_hant: 政府經濟顧問范婉兒表示，展望本港經濟前景維持正面，鄰近主要製造半導體的國家或地區上月出口數據強勁，而人工智能電子產品佔本港出口75%，預期本港今年出口會維持相當強勁增長。她表示，雖然近期市場對人工智能相關投資有所波動，屬風險因素，但未實際影響實體經濟，政府密切關注；根據美國半導體協會對會員的全球銷售數據，明年會有高雙位數的半導體產品銷售增長，預料將支持本港較好出口表現。她指出，本港上月旅客初步估計按年升11%，勞工收入持續上升，消費氣氛穩健，認為本港經濟今年有較強勁增長；不過仍要留意下行風險，因國際油價反覆。考慮到首三季經濟強勁並高於預期，第四季經濟預料穩健增長，當局因此上調全年經濟增長預測至4.8%；至於基本消費物價通脹就向下修訂，由2.5%降至1.9%，與國際油價上升對燃料項目傳導較預期慢有關，但預料會繼續傳導至明年。被問及美國聯儲局潛在加息的影響，她表示要視乎是否進入急速加息周期；市場預計年內或再加息一次，加25點子，明年中或再加息一次，但並不預期會急速加息，估計對本港經濟影響較為輕微。
summary.en: Government Economist Adeline Fan said Hong Kong's economic outlook remains positive: export data from neighbouring major semiconductor-producing economies was strong last month, and AI-related electronic products account for 75 per cent of Hong Kong's exports, so exports are expected to stay very strong this year. She said that although recent market volatility around AI-related investment is a risk factor, it has not yet affected the real economy and the Government is watching closely; according to the US Semiconductor Industry Association's global sales data for its members, semiconductor sales are expected to grow at a high double-digit rate next year, which should support Hong Kong's export performance. She noted that visitor arrivals last month were provisionally estimated to be up 11 per cent year on year, labour income kept rising and consumption sentiment was steady, so Hong Kong's economy should grow strongly this year, although downside risks remain because international oil prices are volatile. Given the strong, above-expectation growth in the first three quarters, the fourth quarter is expected to grow steadily, which is why the full-year growth forecast was raised to 4.8 per cent; underlying consumer price inflation was revised down from 2.5 per cent to 1.9 per cent because the pass-through of higher oil prices to fuel items has been slower than expected, but it is expected to continue into next year. Asked about the impact of potential US Federal Reserve rate rises, she said it depends on whether the Fed enters a rapid hiking cycle; the market expects one more 25-basis-point rise this year and another around the middle of next year, but no rapid hiking is expected, so the impact on Hong Kong should be relatively mild.
summary.zh_hans: 政府经济顾问范婉儿表示，展望本港经济前景维持正面，邻近主要制造半导体的国家或地区上月出口数据强劲，而人工智能电子产品占本港出口75%，预期本港今年出口会维持相当强劲增长。她表示，虽然近期市场对人工智能相关投资有所波动，属风险因素，但未实际影响实体经济，政府密切关注；根据美国半导体协会对会员的全球销售数据，明年会有高双位数的半导体产品销售增长，预料将支持本港较好出口表现。她指出，本港上月旅客初步估计按年升11%，劳工收入持续上升，消费气氛稳健，认为本港经济今年有较强劲增长；不过仍要留意下行风险，因国际油价反复。考虑到首三季经济强劲并高于预期，第四季经济预料稳健增长，当局因此上调全年经济增长预测至4.8%；至于基本消费物价通胀就向下修订，由2.5%降至1.9%，与国际油价上升对燃料项目传导较预期慢有关，但预料会继续传导至明年。被问及美国联储局潜在加息的影响，她表示要视乎是否进入急速加息周期；市场预计年内或再加息一次，加25点子，明年中或再加息一次，但并不预期会急速加息，估计对本港经济影响较为轻微。

title.zh_hant: 內地10月貸款減1000億　時隔兩月再收縮　M2增速創年半最慢
title.en: Mainland October yuan loans shrink by 100 billion yuan, contracting again after two months; M2 growth slowest in over 18 months
title.zh_hans: 内地10月贷款减1000亿　时隔两月再收缩　M2增速创年半最慢

summary.zh_hant: 路透根據人民銀行數字測算，內地10月人民幣貸款再度轉跌，單月減少1000億元，是時隔兩個月再度下跌；首10個月新增貸款11.42萬億元。截至10月底，人民幣貸款餘額按年升4.7%，廣義貨幣供應量（M2）按年升7.1%，創逾1年半最慢增速。截至10月底，社會融資規模存量469.16萬億元，按年升7.2%；首10個月累計增量28.61萬億元，按年少2.29萬億元；路透測算，上月社會融資規模增量1.15萬億元，低於預期。另外，路透根據人行數據計算，至10月底，央行口徑外匯佔款餘額21.72萬億元人民幣，單月減少20.02億元，連續4個月減少。
summary.en: Reuters calculations based on People's Bank of China data show mainland yuan loans fell again in October, down 100 billion yuan in a single month, the first decline in two months; new loans in the first 10 months totalled 11.42 trillion yuan. As of end-October, the outstanding balance of yuan loans rose 4.7 per cent year on year, while broad money supply (M2) grew 7.1 per cent, the slowest pace in more than a year and a half. Total social financing stock stood at 469.16 trillion yuan at end-October, up 7.2 per cent year on year; cumulative social financing in the first 10 months was 28.61 trillion yuan, 2.29 trillion yuan less than a year earlier; Reuters estimated October's social financing increment at 1.15 trillion yuan, below expectations. Separately, Reuters calculations from central bank data put foreign exchange holdings at 21.72 trillion yuan at end-October, down 2.002 billion yuan in the month, a fourth consecutive monthly decline.
summary.zh_hans: 路透根据人民银行数字测算，内地10月人民币贷款再度转跌，单月减少1000亿元，是时隔两个月再度下跌；首10个月新增贷款11.42万亿元。截至10月底，人民币贷款余额按年升4.7%，广义货币供应量（M2）按年升7.1%，创逾1年半最慢增速。截至10月底，社会融资规模存量469.16万亿元，按年升7.2%；首10个月累计增量28.61万亿元，按年少2.29万亿元；路透测算，上月社会融资规模增量1.15万亿元，低于预期。另外，路透根据人行数据计算，至10月底，央行口径外汇占款余额21.72万亿元人民币，单月减少20.02亿元，连续4个月减少。

title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案　鄺港傑認信件內容捏造　圖減輕罪責　花兩年寫信
title.en: Abby Choi murder trial: Kwong Kong-kit admits letter to his brother was fabricated to lighten blame, written over two years
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案　邝港杰认信件内容捏造　图减轻罪责　花两年写信

summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案在高等法院續審，首被告、蔡天鳳前大伯鄺港傑接受另外兩名被告的代表律師盤問。鄺港傑早前作供指，接載蔡天鳳前往接小朋友放學期間，蔡天鳳被同車的弟弟鄺港智襲擊；蔡天鳳前夫鄺港智的代表律師呈上一封數星期前，鄺港傑經另一犯人轉交予鄺港智的信件，指內容與鄺港傑庭上作供有出入，行文非常詳細、思慮周全。信中提及事發前兩兄弟曾經在咖啡室見面、當七人車行駛至獅子山隧道，蔡天鳳叫他致電鄺球「攤牌」或「講數」，又指「知道爸爸也在大埔，就去找爸爸」。鄺港傑回應，自咖啡室後很多內容也是用小聰明創作，並非真實，在庭上作供的內容才是真實版本。律師追問捏造信件內容的原因，鄺港傑解釋，由被捕至還押期間，起初未有法律代表，自己思考如何將各人罪責減輕，與弟弟溝通數次後，利用小聰明花大約兩年時間撰寫信件，以為得出一個好版本；其後有法律代表，向律師交代信件內容，被對方提醒這是非常愚蠢的行為，因此最後決定在庭上說出真相，信件內容非常仔細，不代表是真確。他又確認，父親與蔡天鳳發生爭執，主要是由於照顧小朋友的事情，與加多利山物業無關；殺害蔡天鳳對自己和父親也沒有好處。審訊星期一繼續。
summary.en: The Abby Choi murder trial continued in the High Court, with first defendant Kwong Kong-kit, Choi's former brother-in-law, being cross-examined by lawyers for the other two defendants. Kwong had earlier testified that while he was driving Choi to pick up her children from school, her former husband's younger brother Kwong Kong-chi attacked her in the car. A lawyer for Kwong Kong-chi produced a letter Kwong Kong-kit had passed to his brother via another inmate several weeks earlier, saying its contents differed from his court testimony and were written in great detail and with careful thought. The letter mentioned the brothers meeting at a café before the incident, and that as the seven-seater travelled through Lion Rock Tunnel, Choi asked him to call Kwong Kau to "showdown" or "negotiate", adding "knowing dad was in Tai Po, go find dad". Kwong replied that much of the letter after the café meeting was invented with "cleverness" and was not true, and that his court testimony is the true version. Asked why he fabricated the letter, Kwong explained that between his arrest and remand he initially had no legal representation, and thought about how to lighten everyone's culpability; after communicating with his brother several times, he spent about two years writing the letter with his "cleverness", thinking he had produced a good version. After he later had a lawyer, he told the lawyer about the letter and was warned it was a very foolish thing to do, so he finally decided to tell the truth in court; the letter being very detailed does not mean it is accurate. He also confirmed that the dispute between his father and Choi was mainly about childcare, not the Mount Kellett property, and that killing Choi brought no benefit to either himself or his father. The trial continues on Monday.
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案在高等法院续审，首被告、蔡天凤前大伯邝港杰接受另外两名被告的代表律师盘问。邝港杰早前作供指，接载蔡天凤前往接小朋友放学期间，蔡天凤被同车的弟弟邝港智袭击；蔡天凤前夫邝港智的代表律师呈上一封数星期前，邝港杰经另一犯人转交予邝港智的信件，指内容与邝港杰庭上作供有出入，行文非常详细、思虑周全。信中提及事发前两兄弟曾经在咖啡室见面、当七人车行驶至狮子山隧道，蔡天凤叫他致电邝球「摊牌」或「讲数」，又指「知道爸爸也在大埔，就去找爸爸」。邝港杰回应，自咖啡室后很多内容也是用小聪明创作，并非真实，在庭上作供的内容才是真实版本。律师追问捏造信件内容的原因，邝港杰解释，由被捕至还押期间，起初未有法律代表，自己思考如何将各人罪责减轻，与弟弟沟通数次后，利用小聪明花大约两年时间撰写信件，以为得出一个好版本；其后有法律代表，向律师交代信件内容，被对方提醒这是非常愚蠢的行为，因此最后决定在庭上说出真相，信件内容非常仔细，不代表是真确。他又确认，父亲与蔡天凤发生争执，主要是由于照顾小朋友的事情，与加多利山物业无关；杀害蔡天凤对自己和父亲也没有好处。审讯星期一继续。

title.zh_hant: 陳茂波：研究立法設受保護單元公司　拓展海上保險　航運風險池已保逾千船
title.en: Paul Chan: Hong Kong studying law for protected cell companies to grow marine insurance; shipping risk pool already covers 1,000-plus vessels
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：研究立法设受保护单元公司　拓展海上保险　航运风险池已保逾千船

summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波在亞洲保險論壇上致辭時表示，保險業正在開拓的其中一個市場是海上保險，去年5家保險公司聯合推出「航運專項風險池」，為香港和內地船東提供戰爭與相關風險保障，現時已承保超過1000艘船舶，政府及保監局將與業界合作，擴大風險池承保能力。他指出，本港正積極發展保險掛鈎證券，正研究透過立法建立一種「受保護單元公司」架構，讓多宗交易在同一家公司內進行，同時在法律上分隔各自的資產與負債，簡化相關安排並降低設立成本；政府亦會拓展專項保險，配合黃金、綠色燃料及低空經濟發展。他提到，當局將降低保險公司投資本港及內地認可基建項目要求，今年底生效，有助釋放更多資源，服務北部都會區等基建。他強調，基建投資需要長線融資，保險公司則需要投資資產，有關舉措可同時兼顧長期承諾，以及保障投保客戶利益。他說，地緣政治局勢正重塑供應鏈和貿易版圖，氣候變化、數碼攻擊、人工智能等，正改變保險業承保範圍和運作模式，業界需要增強韌性和能力。他又提到，國家金融監管總局支持內地保險機構通過滬深港通投資本港交易所買賣基金（ETF），有助擴闊內地保險機構的投資選擇，增強本港資本市場流動性。
summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan told the Asian Insurance Forum that marine insurance is one of the markets the insurance industry is developing: five insurers jointly launched a "shipping special risk pool" last year, providing war and related risk cover for Hong Kong and Mainland shipowners, and it now covers more than 1,000 vessels; the Government and the Insurance Authority will work with the industry to expand the pool's underwriting capacity. He said Hong Kong is actively developing insurance-linked securities and is studying legislation to establish a "protected cell company" structure, allowing multiple transactions within one company while legally segregating each one's assets and liabilities, simplifying arrangements and lowering set-up costs; the Government will also expand specialty insurance to support gold, green fuel and the low-altitude economy. He said the authorities will lower requirements for insurers investing in recognised infrastructure projects in Hong Kong and the Mainland, taking effect by the end of the year, helping to release more resources for infrastructure such as the Northern Metropolis; infrastructure investment needs long-term financing while insurers need investment assets, and the measure serves both long-term commitments and policyholders' interests. He said geopolitics is reshaping supply chains and trade, while climate change, cyberattacks and artificial intelligence are changing the scope and operation of insurance underwriting, and the industry needs greater resilience and capability. He added that the National Financial Regulatory Administration supports Mainland insurers investing in Hong Kong exchange-traded funds (ETFs) through Stock Connect, widening their investment choices and boosting liquidity in Hong Kong's capital market.
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波在亚洲保险论坛上致辞时表示，保险业正在开拓的其中一个市场是海上保险，去年5家保险公司联合推出「航运专项风险池」，为香港和内地船东提供战争与相关风险保障，现时已承保超过1000艘船舶，政府及保监局将与业界合作，扩大风险池承保能力。他指出，本港正积极发展保险挂钩证券，正研究透过立法建立一种「受保护单元公司」架构，让多宗交易在同一家公司内进行，同时在法律上分隔各自的资产与负债，简化相关安排并降低设立成本；政府亦会拓展专项保险，配合黄金、绿色燃料及低空经济发展。他提到，当局将降低保险公司投资本港及内地认可基建项目要求，今年底生效，有助释放更多资源，服务北部都会区等基建。他强调，基建投资需要长线融资，保险公司则需要投资资产，有关举措可同时兼顾长期承诺，以及保障投保客户利益。他说，地缘政治局势正重塑供应链和贸易版图，气候变化、数码攻击、人工智能等，正改变保险业承保范围和运作模式，业界需要增强韧性和能力。他又提到，国家金融监管总局支持内地保险机构通过沪深港通投资本港交易所买卖基金（ETF），有助扩阔内地保险机构的投资选择，增强本港资本市场流动性。

title.zh_hant: 新資本投資者計劃申請破5000宗　料吸1500億投資　逾3000宗已批
title.en: New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme passes 5,000 applications, set to draw HK$150 billion; over 3,000 already approved
title.zh_hans: 新资本投资者计划申请破5000宗　料吸1500亿投资　逾3000宗已批

summary.zh_hant: 財經事務及庫務局表示，至10月底，新資本投資者入境計劃接獲申請突破5000宗，預計可為香港帶來超過1500億元投資金額，當中超過3000宗申請已獲核實完成投資，並得到正式批准。財庫局表示，自2024年3月實施新資本投資者入境計劃以來，持續吸引環球高淨值人士及資本落戶香港，近年資本投資者與家族辦公室落戶香港都錄得強勁增長。政府已先後落實一系列優化計劃的措施，而為締造更具競爭力的稅務環境，早前已向立法會提交有關優化基金、家族投資控權工具及附帶權益的優惠稅制的立法建議。財庫局指出，考慮到審議法案過程中收到的意見，政府將提出修正案，包括放寬「貴金屬」作為可獲免稅的合資格投資的20%投資額上限，以及擴大「基金」的定義，以納入沒有募資截止日期的「永續基金」等；當局預期能夠回應業界訴求，為基金與家辦提供更大彈性和便利，政府目標今年內通過相關條例草案。
summary.en: The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said that by the end of October, applications under the New Capital Investment Entrant Scheme had exceeded 5,000, expected to bring more than HK$150 billion in investment to Hong Kong, with more than 3,000 applications verified as having completed their investments and formally approved. The bureau said that since the scheme was launched in March 2024, it has continued to attract high-net-worth individuals and capital from around the world to settle in Hong Kong, and both capital investors and family offices setting up in Hong Kong have recorded strong growth in recent years. The Government has implemented a series of enhancements to the scheme, and to create a more competitive tax environment, it earlier submitted to the Legislative Council a bill on preferential tax treatment for funds, family-owned investment holding vehicles and carried interest. The bureau said that, taking into account views received during the bill's scrutiny, the Government will propose amendments, including relaxing the 20 per cent investment cap on "precious metals" as eligible tax-exempt investments and expanding the definition of "fund" to include "perpetual funds" with no fundraising deadline; the authorities expect the changes to respond to industry demands and give funds and family offices greater flexibility and convenience, with the Government aiming to pass the bill within this year.
summary.zh_hans: 财经事务及库务局表示，至10月底，新资本投资者入境计划接获申请突破5000宗，预计可为香港带来超过1500亿元投资金额，当中超过3000宗申请已获核实完成投资，并得到正式批准。财库局表示，自2024年3月实施新资本投资者入境计划以来，持续吸引环球高净值人士及资本落户香港，近年资本投资者与家族办公室落户香港都录得强劲增长。政府已先后落实一系列优化计划的措施，而为缔造更具竞争力的税务环境，早前已向立法会提交有关优化基金、家族投资控权工具及附带权益的优惠税制的立法建议。财库局指出，考虑到审议法案过程中收到的意见，政府将提出修正案，包括放宽「贵金属」作为可获免税的合资格投资的20%投资额上限，以及扩大「基金」的定义，以纳入没有募资截止日期的「永续基金」等；当局预期能够回应业界诉求，为基金与家办提供更大弹性和便利，政府目标今年内通过相关条例草案。
