title.zh_hant: 京都爆發高致病性禽流感　食安中心即時停進口京都家禽肉及禽蛋
title.en: Highly pathogenic bird flu hits Kyoto: food safety watchdog halts poultry meat and egg imports from the prefecture
title.zh_hans: 京都爆发高致病性禽流感　食安中心即时停进口京都家禽肉及禽蛋

summary.zh_hant: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心宣布，因應日本農林水產省通報京都府爆發高致病性H5禽流感，即時指示業界暫停從該區進口家禽肉及產品，包括禽蛋，以保障香港公眾健康。據政府統計處資料，今年首九個月香港從日本進口約1,030噸急凍家禽肉及約2.4994億隻禽蛋。食安中心表示已就事件聯絡日本當局，並會密切留意世界動物衞生組織及相關當局發布的禽流感疫情資訊，因應情況發展採取適當行動。
summary.en: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department announced that, following a notification from Japan's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries about an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza in Kyoto Prefecture, it has instructed the trade to suspend imports of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, from the area with immediate effect to protect public health in Hong Kong. According to the Census and Statistics Department, Hong Kong imported about 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry meat and about 249.94 million poultry eggs from Japan in the first nine months of this year. The centre said it has contacted the Japanese authority and will closely monitor information from the World Organisation for Animal Health and relevant authorities on the outbreak, taking appropriate action as the situation develops.
summary.zh_hans: 食物环境卫生署食物安全中心宣布，因应日本农林水产省通报京都府爆发高致病性H5禽流感，即时指示业界暂停从该区进口家禽肉及产品，包括禽蛋，以保障香港公众健康。据政府统计处资料，今年首九个月香港从日本进口约1,030吨急冻家禽肉及约2.4994亿只禽蛋。食安中心表示已就事件联络日本当局，并会密切留意世界动物卫生组织及相关当局发布的禽流感疫情资讯，因应情况发展采取适当行动。

title.zh_hant: 二手樓價連跌5周　CCL創5個月低位　新界西一周跌1.68%
title.en: Secondary home prices fall for a fifth week, CCL at a five-month low; New Territories West down 1.68% in a week
title.zh_hans: 二手楼价连跌5周　CCL创5个月低位　新界西一周跌1.68%

summary.zh_hant: 反映本港二手樓價走勢的中原城市領先指數（CCL）最新報158.61點，按周跌0.31%，連跌5個星期，累計回落1.61%，指數創5個月以來低位。大型屋苑和中小型單位樓價分別按周跌約0.5%和0.4%，大型單位按周升0.15%，結束連續4周下跌。四區樓價中，新界西按周跌1.68%，九龍跌0.4%，港島及新界東變動不大。CCL今年以來累計升10.06%，港島和新界東升幅接近12%。中原地產表示，多個一手新盤低價熱銷，攤薄二手購買力，加上港股下跌，業主態度開始軟化，需要擴大議價空間才獲買家承接，影響樓價持續調整回軟。
summary.en: The Centa-City Leading Index (CCL), which tracks secondary home prices in Hong Kong, was last reported at 158.61, down 0.31 per cent week on week, falling for a fifth consecutive week and down a cumulative 1.61 per cent, its lowest in five months. Prices in large housing estates and small-to-medium units fell about 0.5 per cent and 0.4 per cent respectively week on week, while large units rose 0.15 per cent, ending a four-week decline. Among the four districts, New Territories West fell 1.68 per cent week on week, Kowloon fell 0.4 per cent, and Hong Kong Island and New Territories East were little changed. The CCL is up 10.06 per cent so far this year, with Hong Kong Island and New Territories East up nearly 12 per cent. Centaline Property said several new launches selling at low prices have diluted secondary-market buying power, and with Hong Kong stocks falling, owners are softening their stance and need to widen the bargaining room before buyers will commit, keeping prices on a softening trend.
summary.zh_hans: 反映本港二手楼价走势的中原城市领先指数（CCL）最新报158.61点，按周跌0.31%，连跌5个星期，累计回落1.61%，指数创5个月以来低位。大型屋苑和中小型单位楼价分别按周跌约0.5%和0.4%，大型单位按周升0.15%，结束连续4周下跌。四区楼价中，新界西按周跌1.68%，九龙跌0.4%，港岛及新界东变动不大。CCL今年以来累计升10.06%，港岛和新界东升幅接近12%。中原地产表示，多个一手新盘低价热销，摊薄二手购买力，加上港股下跌，业主态度开始软化，需要扩大议价空间才获买家承接，影响楼价持续调整回软。

title.zh_hant: 第三季經濟勁增5.2%　全年增長預測上調至4.8%　通脹預測降至1.9%
title.en: Hong Kong economy grows 5.2% in Q3; full-year forecast raised to 4.8%, inflation forecast cut to 1.9%
title.zh_hans: 第三季经济劲增5.2%　全年增长预测上调至4.8%　通胀预测降至1.9%

summary.zh_hant: 政府今日發表《2026年第三季經濟報告》連同修訂數字。第三季本地生產總值按年實質增長5.2%，較第二季4.2%加快；首三季合計增長5.1%，是五年來同期最快。貨品出口受惠人工智能相關電子產品需求強勁，實質按年急升30.3%，服務輸出增4.3%，私人消費增2.9%連續第六季擴張，整體投資開支升7.5%，經季節性調整失業率微升至3.9%。政府將全年經濟增長預測由8月覆檢的3.5%至4.5%上調至4.8%，基本通脹率及整體通脹率預測則分別由2.5%及2.6%下調至1.9%及2.0%。
summary.en: The Government today released the Third Quarter Economic Report 2026 together with revised figures. Real GDP grew 5.2 per cent year on year in the third quarter, accelerating from 4.2 per cent in the second quarter; growth for the first three quarters combined was 5.1 per cent, the fastest in five years for the corresponding period. Total exports of goods surged 30.3 per cent in real terms on robust demand for AI-related electronic products, exports of services rose 4.3 per cent, private consumption grew 2.9 per cent for a sixth consecutive quarter, overall investment expenditure rose 7.5 per cent, and the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate edged up to 3.9 per cent. The Government raised its full-year GDP growth forecast to 4.8 per cent from 3.5 to 4.5 per cent in the August review, and cut its underlying and headline inflation forecasts to 1.9 per cent and 2.0 per cent from 2.5 per cent and 2.6 per cent respectively.
summary.zh_hans: 政府今日发表《2026年第三季经济报告》连同修订数字。第三季本地生产总值按年实质增长5.2%，较第二季4.2%加快；首三季合计增长5.1%，是五年来同期最快。货品出口受惠人工智能相关电子产品需求强劲，实质按年急升30.3%，服务输出增4.3%，私人消费增2.9%连续第六季扩张，整体投资开支升7.5%，经季节性调整失业率微升至3.9%。政府将全年经济增长预测由8月覆检的3.5%至4.5%上调至4.8%，基本通胀率及整体通胀率预测则分别由2.5%及2.6%下调至1.9%及2.0%。

title.zh_hant: 洪水橋物流圈接16份意向書　首批5幅地　32公頃打造現代物流樞紐
title.en: Hung Shui Kiu logistics cluster draws 16 expressions of interest; first five sites on 32 hectares to build a modern logistics hub
title.zh_hans: 洪水桥物流圈接16份意向书　首批5幅地　32公顷打造现代物流枢纽

summary.zh_hant: 運輸及物流局聯同土木工程拓展署於今年8月13日，邀請物流業界及其他持份者就洪水橋／廈村新發展區現代物流圈選定地塊的發展提交意向書；提交意向書今日（11月13日）截止，共接獲16份，分別來自發展商、物流營運商、物流業界團體及專業服務提供者。政府在洪水橋／廈村新發展區預留約32公頃土地發展現代物流圈，位處北部都會區西部，鄰近深圳灣口岸，連接香港國際機場及葵青貨櫃碼頭，位置優越。物流圈發展採用「企業主導」原則，匯聚物流企業及相關配套服務，推動現代化、高增值、智慧及綠色物流服務發展，鞏固香港作為國際物流樞紐的地位。今次邀請提交意向書涵蓋物流圈內首批5幅選定地塊，旨在了解市場對發展該等地塊的興趣，並收集業界對發展要求及賣地安排的意見，為賣地工作作準備。
summary.en: The Transport and Logistics Bureau, jointly with the Civil Engineering and Development Department, invited the logistics industry and other stakeholders on August 13, 2026 to submit expressions of interest (EOI) for the development of selected land parcels of the modern logistics cluster in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area; submissions closed today (November 13), with a total of 16 submissions received from developers, logistics operators, logistics industry associations and professional services providers. The Government has reserved approximately 32 hectares of land in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area in the Northern Metropolis for a modern logistics cluster, strategically located in the western part of the Northern Metropolis close to the Shenzhen Bay Port, with convenient connections to Hong Kong International Airport and the Kwai Tsing Container Terminals. Development of the cluster will adopt an "enterprise-oriented" principle, bringing together logistics enterprises and related supporting services to promote modern, high value-added, smart and green logistics services, reinforcing Hong Kong's position as an international logistics hub. The EOI covers the first batch of five selected sites in the cluster, aiming to gauge market interest and collect industry views on development requirements and land disposal arrangements in preparation for land tender exercises.
summary.zh_hans: 运输及物流局联同土木工程拓展署于今年8月13日，邀请物流业界及其他持份者就洪水桥／厦村新发展区现代物流圈选定地块的发展提交意向书；提交意向书今日（11月13日）截止，共接获16份，分别来自发展商、物流营运商、物流业界团体及专业服务提供者。政府在洪水桥／厦村新发展区预留约32公顷土地发展现代物流圈，位处北部都会区西部，邻近深圳湾口岸，连接香港国际机场及葵青货柜码头，位置优越。物流圈发展采用「企业主导」原则，汇聚物流企业及相关配套服务，推动现代化、高增值、智慧及绿色物流服务发展，巩固香港作为国际物流枢纽的地位。今次邀请提交意向书涵盖物流圈内首批5幅选定地块，旨在了解市场对发展该等地块的兴趣，并收集业界对发展要求及卖地安排的意见，为卖地工作作准备。

title.zh_hant: 港股連跌3日　恒指失守24000點　低收370點　全星期累跌3.5%
title.en: Hong Kong stocks fall for a third day: Hang Seng loses 24,000, closes 370 points lower; down 3.5% for the week
title.zh_hans: 港股连跌3日　恒指失守24000点　低收370点　全星期累跌3.5%

summary.zh_hant: 港股連跌第三日，恒生指數失守24000點，創逾一星期新低。午後跌幅擴大，最多跌逾410點，收報23637點，跌370點，跌幅約1.6%，主板成交約1959億元。科技指數收報3813點，跌3%；晶片、AI大模型及硬件股沽壓大，華虹、聯想、MINIMAX、智譜跌逾6%至10%，中芯績後跌約0.5%；汽車股跌勢未止，比亞迪、理想、小鵬、蔚來跌近4%至逾5%；石油股普遍反彈，中石化及中石油分別升近2%及近3%。總結全星期，恒指累跌約3.5%，科指跌6.5%，雙雙扭轉上星期升勢。
summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a third straight day, with the Hang Seng Index losing the 24,000 level to a more than one-week low. Losses widened in the afternoon to more than 410 points at most, and the index closed at 23,637, down 370 points or about 1.6 per cent, with main-board turnover of about HK$195.9 billion. The Tech Index closed at 3,813, down 3 per cent; chip, AI model and hardware stocks were under heavy selling pressure, with Hua Hong, Lenovo, MINIMAX and Zhipu down more than 6 to 10 per cent and SMIC down about 0.5 per cent after results; auto stocks kept falling, with BYD, Li Auto, XPeng and NIO down nearly 4 to more than 5 per cent; oil stocks generally rebounded, with Sinopec and PetroChina up nearly 2 per cent and nearly 3 per cent respectively. For the week, the Hang Seng fell about 3.5 per cent and the Tech Index 6.5 per cent, both reversing last week's gains.
summary.zh_hans: 港股连跌第三日，恒生指数失守24000点，创逾一星期新低。午后跌幅扩大，最多跌逾410点，收报23637点，跌370点，跌幅约1.6%，主板成交约1959亿元。科技指数收报3813点，跌3%；芯片、AI大模型及硬件股沽压大，华虹、联想、MINIMAX、智谱跌逾6%至10%，中芯绩后跌约0.5%；汽车股跌势未止，比亚迪、理想、小鹏、蔚来跌近4%至逾5%；石油股普遍反弹，中石化及中石油分别升近2%及近3%。总结全星期，恒指累跌约3.5%，科指跌6.5%，双双扭转上星期升势。

title.zh_hant: 微軟大規模死機波及逾70國　Outlook、Copilot癱瘓逾10小時　修復未如理想
title.en: Microsoft outage hits more than 70 countries: Outlook and Copilot down for over 10 hours, fixes falling short
title.zh_hans: 微软大规模死机波及逾70国　Outlook、Copilot瘫痪逾10小时　修复未如理想

summary.zh_hant: 微軟多項服務全球大規模死機，電郵系統Outlook及人工智能Copilot等服務受連線問題影響。公司表示今次並非網絡安全事故引起，正努力修復。據英國廣播公司報道，監測網站顯示事件影響超過70個國家用戶，已持續超過10小時；星期四單是Outlook故障宗數最高約14萬宗，後來回落至2.8萬宗。微軟稱故障原因是多台伺服器因負載過高意外離線，正盡可能將流量轉移至其他路徑及簡化流程，令伺服器恢復上線，但承認目前修復措施未達預期效果。報道指超過4.3億人使用Microsoft 365應用程式，OpenAI及Anthropic亦表示因今次事故遭遇問題。
summary.en: Several Microsoft services suffered a large-scale global outage, with email system Outlook and AI assistant Copilot among those hit by connectivity problems. The company said the outage was not caused by a cybersecurity incident and that it is working on repairs. The BBC reported, citing a monitoring website, that the incident affected users in more than 70 countries and had lasted over 10 hours; on Thursday, Outlook-related outage reports peaked at about 140,000 before easing to 28,000. Microsoft said the fault was caused by multiple servers unexpectedly going offline under excessive load, and that it is diverting traffic to other routes and simplifying processes to bring servers back online, while conceding that current repair efforts have not met expectations. The report said more than 430 million people use Microsoft 365 applications, and OpenAI and Anthropic also said they were affected by the incident.
summary.zh_hans: 微软多项服务全球大规模死机，电邮系统Outlook及人工智能Copilot等服务受连线问题影响。公司表示今次并非网络安全事故引起，正努力修复。据英国广播公司报道，监测网站显示事件影响超过70个国家用户，已持续超过10小时；星期四单是Outlook故障宗数最高约14万宗，后来回落至2.8万宗。微软称故障原因是多台服务器因负载过高意外离线，正尽可能将流量转移至其他路径及简化流程，令服务器恢复上线，但承认目前修复措施未达预期效果。报道指超过4.3亿人使用Microsoft 365应用程序，OpenAI及Anthropic亦表示因今次事故遭遇问题。

title.zh_hant: 美推晶片法案堵中國取算力　外交部：中方一貫反對濫用出口管制
title.en: US chip bill would block China's access to computing power; foreign ministry says China consistently opposes abuse of export controls
title.zh_hans: 美推芯片法案堵中国取算力　外交部：中方一贯反对滥用出口管制

summary.zh_hant: 外交部表示，中美雙方應當共同落實好兩國元首達成的重要共識，維護中美經貿關係穩定發展態勢。在外交部例行記者會上，有記者提問，美國議員與商務部正推動通過晶片法案，阻止中國公司透過國外渠道獲取美國算力，詢問中方是否認為有關限制違反中美貿易休戰協議，以及鑑於APEC峰會即將召開，中方有何回應。發言人毛寧重申，中方一貫反對濫用出口管制措施，擾亂全球產供鏈穩定，有關做法不符合任何一方利益。
summary.en: The foreign ministry said China and the United States should jointly implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and maintain the stable development of China-US economic and trade relations. At the ministry's regular press briefing, a reporter asked about US lawmakers and the Department of Commerce pushing a chip bill to stop Chinese companies from obtaining US computing power through overseas channels, whether China considers the restrictions a violation of the China-US trade truce, and what China's response is given the upcoming APEC summit. Spokesperson Mao Ning reiterated that China consistently opposes the abuse of export control measures that disrupt the stability of global industrial and supply chains, and that such practices serve no party's interests.
summary.zh_hans: 外交部表示，中美双方应当共同落实好两国元首达成的重要共识，维护中美经贸关系稳定发展态势。在外交部例行记者会上，有记者提问，美国议员与商务部正推动通过芯片法案，阻止中国公司透过国外渠道获取美国算力，询问中方是否认为有关限制违反中美贸易休战协议，以及鉴于APEC峰会即将召开，中方有何回应。发言人毛宁重申，中方一贯反对滥用出口管制措施，扰乱全球产供链稳定，有关做法不符合任何一方利益。

title.zh_hant: 微軟死機波及本港　付貨人：接單確認受阻　議員倡做好後備方案
title.en: Microsoft outage reaches Hong Kong: shippers say orders and confirmations disrupted; lawmaker urges backup plans
title.zh_hans: 微软死机波及本港　付货人：接单确认受阻　议员倡做好后备方案

summary.zh_hant: 微軟多項服務發生大規模死機，持續多個小時，大批用戶受影響。香港付貨人委員會主席許彼得表示，不少行內人士包括製造業及物流業公司都表示受影響，主要是通訊方面，例如公司接單及確認進度等都受不同程度影響，生意上未至於停擺，但因通訊延誤造成不同程度損失。立法會議員吳傑莊表示，全球不少機構、企業甚至學校都有使用微軟系統電郵或辦公軟件，立法會電郵同樣一度未能使用，但因有另一系統支援而無影響通訊。他認為經過今次事件，任何機構及政府公共設施都應該做好後備方案，不能依靠單一系統，否則有機會令服務被迫暫停，短時間內難以恢復。
summary.en: Several Microsoft services suffered a large-scale outage lasting many hours, affecting large numbers of users. Hong Kong Shippers' Council chairman Peter Shiu said many in the trade, including manufacturers and logistics firms, reported being affected, mainly in communications such as taking orders and confirming progress, with varying degrees of disruption; business did not grind to a halt, but communication delays caused losses of varying degrees. Legislative Council member Johnny Ng said many institutions, companies and even schools around the world use Microsoft email or office software, and the Legislative Council's email was also temporarily unusable, though a second system kept communications unaffected. He said that after this incident, all organisations and public facilities should have backup plans in place and not rely on a single system, or services could be forced to stop with recovery difficult in a short time.
summary.zh_hans: 微软多项服务发生大规模死机，持续多个小时，大批用户受影响。香港付货人委员会主席许彼得表示，不少行内人士包括制造业及物流业公司都表示受影响，主要是通讯方面，例如公司接单及确认进度等都受不同程度影响，生意上未至于停摆，但因通讯延误造成不同程度损失。立法会议员吴杰庄表示，全球不少机构、企业甚至学校都有使用微软系统电邮或办公软件，立法会电邮同样一度未能使用，但因有另一系统支援而无影响通讯。他认为经过今次事件，任何机构及政府公共设施都应该做好后备方案，不能依靠单一系统，否则有机会令服务被迫暂停，短时间内难以恢复。

title.zh_hant: 港珠澳大橋半馬周日開跑　特別交通安排明起分階段實施
title.en: Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge half marathon runs Sunday; special traffic arrangements roll out in phases from tomorrow
title.zh_hans: 港珠澳大桥半马周日开跑　特别交通安排明起分阶段实施

summary.zh_hant: 警方宣布，為配合港珠澳大橋（香港段）半馬拉松2026，將於周六至周日實施特別交通安排，呼籲市民及早規劃行程。首階段周六下午4時起，港珠澳大橋香港連接路往香港方向左線及中線封閉，前往香港的駕駛者須使用右線。港珠澳大橋香港口岸貨車出境通關廣場後一段貨車出境通道，將於周六晚上約9時至周日下午約3時臨時封閉。警方會視乎當區交通及人流情況實施交通安排，市民應保持忍讓及遵從現場警務人員指示。
summary.en: Police announced that special traffic arrangements will be implemented from Saturday to Sunday to facilitate the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge (Hong Kong Section) Half Marathon 2026, and urged the public to plan journeys in advance. In the first phase, from 4pm on Saturday, the left and middle lanes of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Link Road heading towards Hong Kong will be closed, and drivers heading to Hong Kong must use the right lane. A section of the goods vehicle outbound channel after the goods vehicle outbound clearance plaza at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port will be temporarily closed from about 9pm on Saturday to about 3pm on Sunday. Police will implement traffic arrangements depending on traffic and pedestrian conditions in the area, and the public should remain patient and follow the instructions of police officers on site.
summary.zh_hans: 警方宣布，为配合港珠澳大桥（香港段）半马拉松2026，将于周六至周日实施特别交通安排，呼吁市民及早规划行程。首阶段周六下午4时起，港珠澳大桥香港连接路往香港方向左线及中线封闭，前往香港的驾驶者须使用右线。港珠澳大桥香港口岸货车出境通关广场后一段货车出境通道，将于周六晚上约9时至周日下午约3时临时封闭。警方会视乎当区交通及人流情况实施交通安排，市民应保持忍让及遵从现场警务人员指示。

title.zh_hant: 蔡樹強升任副廉政專員兼執行處首長　11月17日生效　接替丘樹春
title.en: Choi Shu-keung named Deputy Commissioner of ICAC and head of Operations from November 17, succeeding Yau Shu-chun
title.zh_hans: 蔡树强升任副廉政专员兼执行处首长　11月17日生效　接替丘树春

summary.zh_hant: 廉政專員胡英明公布，執行處處長蔡樹強獲委任為副廉政專員，同時出任執行處首長，本月17日起生效，接替同日展開退休前休假的丘樹春。胡英明表示，蔡樹強投身廉署28年，在公私營領域反貪均累積深厚經驗，具備卓越領導才能及豐富行政管理知識，深信他能帶領執行處維持高度專業反貪水平，繼續有效打擊貪污，維護香港作為全球廉潔之都的美譽。現年54歲的蔡樹強於1998年加入廉署任職調查主任，2012年晉升執行處助理處長，2022年起出任執行處處長。胡英明同時感謝丘樹春逾30年堅守反貪使命，過去10年出任副廉政專員及執行處首長期間帶領執行處打擊貪污，在廉政建設作出貢獻。
summary.en: Commissioner of the ICAC Woo Ying-ming announced that Director of Operations Choi Shu-keung has been appointed Deputy Commissioner, concurrently serving as head of the Operations Department, with effect from November 17, succeeding Yau Shu-chun, who begins pre-retirement leave the same day. Woo said Choi, who has served in the ICAC for 28 years, has accumulated deep experience in fighting corruption in both the public and private sectors, with outstanding leadership and rich administrative management knowledge, and he is confident Choi will lead the Operations Department to maintain a highly professional anti-corruption standard, continuing to combat corruption effectively and uphold Hong Kong's reputation as a global clean city. Choi, 54, joined the ICAC as an investigating officer in 1998, was promoted to Assistant Director of Operations in 2012, and has served as Director of Operations since 2022. Woo also thanked Yau for more than 30 years of dedication to the anti-corruption mission, including leading the Operations Department in fighting corruption over the past decade as Deputy Commissioner and head of Operations.
summary.zh_hans: 廉政专员胡英明公布，执行处处长蔡树强获委任为副廉政专员，同时出任执行处首长，本月17日起生效，接替同日展开退休前休假的丘树春。胡英明表示，蔡树强投身廉署28年，在公私营领域反贪均累积深厚经验，具备卓越领导才能及丰富行政管理知识，深信他能带领执行处维持高度专业反贪水平，继续有效打击贪污，维护香港作为全球廉洁之都的美誉。现年54岁的蔡树强于1998年加入廉署任职调查主任，2012年晋升执行处助理处长，2022年起出任执行处处长。胡英明同时感谢丘树春逾30年坚守反贪使命，过去10年出任副廉政专员及执行处首长期间带领执行处打击贪污，在廉政建设作出贡献。

title.zh_hant: APEC深圳峰會下周登場　外交部：期待各方凝聚共識　達成領導人宣言
title.en: APEC summit opens in Shenzhen next week: foreign ministry hopes all sides build consensus and adopt a leaders' declaration
title.zh_hans: APEC深圳峰会下周登场　外交部：期待各方凝聚共识　达成领导人宣言

summary.zh_hant: 國家主席習近平將出席下星期在深圳舉行的亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議及相關活動。外交部發言人毛寧表示，今年是中國相隔12年再次擔任APEC東道主，中方期待各方進一步凝聚共識，達成領導人深圳宣言，在貿易、互聯互通、數字經濟和人工智能等重要領域取得更多務實成果，為亞太以至全球繁榮增長注入強勁動力。對於中美俄元首會晤提問，毛寧表示中方與相關方保持溝通，如有進一步資訊會及時發布。
summary.en: President Xi Jinping will attend the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and related events in Shenzhen next week. Foreign ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said this year marks China's return as APEC host after 12 years, and China hopes all parties will further build consensus and adopt a leaders' Shenzhen declaration, achieving more practical outcomes in trade, connectivity, the digital economy and artificial intelligence, injecting strong momentum into prosperity and growth in the Asia-Pacific and beyond. On a question about a meeting of the Chinese, US and Russian leaders, Mao said China is in communication with the relevant parties and will release further information in a timely manner if there is any.
summary.zh_hans: 国家主席习近平将出席下星期在深圳举行的亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议及相关活动。外交部发言人毛宁表示，今年是中国相隔12年再次担任APEC东道主，中方期待各方进一步凝聚共识，达成领导人深圳宣言，在贸易、互联互通、数字经济和人工智能等重要领域取得更多务实成果，为亚太以至全球繁荣增长注入强劲动力。对于中美俄元首会晤提问，毛宁表示中方与相关方保持沟通，如有进一步资讯会及时发布。

title.zh_hant: 麗港城擬用人臉識別門禁　涉8000戶　私隱公署主動循規審查
title.en: Laguna City plans facial-recognition access for 8,000-plus homes; privacy watchdog opens compliance check
title.zh_hans: 丽港城拟用人脸识别门禁　涉8000户　私隐公署主动循规审查

summary.zh_hant: 個人資料私隱專員公署表示，留意到負責管理麗港城屋苑的物業管理公司計劃引入人臉識別門禁系統，引起部分住戶對個人資料私隱的關注。公署指出，面容影像屬於敏感個人資料，加上可能涉及8000多戶，為確保住戶個人資料獲得充分保障，已主動對有關系統進行循規審查，要求相關機構提供進一步資料，確保其在收集、持有、處理或使用生物辨識資料時遵從《個人資料（私隱）條例》及有關保障資料原則，特別是資料保安規定。
summary.en: The Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data said it has noted that the property management company of Laguna City plans to introduce a facial-recognition access control system, raising concerns among some residents about personal data privacy. The office said facial images are sensitive personal data and the system could involve more than 8,000 households, so to ensure residents' personal data is fully protected it has proactively launched a compliance check on the system, asking the relevant organisation to provide further information to ensure its collection, holding, processing or use of biometric data complies with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance and the relevant data protection principles, in particular data security requirements.
summary.zh_hans: 个人资料私隐专员公署表示，留意到负责管理丽港城屋苑的物业管理公司计划引入人脸识别门禁系统，引起部分住户对个人资料私隐的关注。公署指出，面容影像属于敏感个人资料，加上可能涉及8000多户，为确保住户个人资料获得充分保障，已主动对有关系统进行循规审查，要求相关机构提供进一步资料，确保其在收集、持有、处理或使用生物辨识资料时遵从《个人资料（私隐）条例》及有关保障资料原则，特别是资料保安规定。

title.zh_hant: 滬股低收約0.6%　創業板急跌逾3%　全星期齊跌扭轉上周升勢
title.en: Shanghai stocks close about 0.6% lower as ChiNext plunges over 3%; all major mainland gauges down for the week
title.zh_hans: 沪股低收约0.6%　创业板急跌逾3%　全星期齐跌扭转上周升势

summary.zh_hant: 內地股市低收，創業板指數跌幅較大；算力硬件及元件等股份下跌，銀行、保險、白酒、影視及豬肉股造好。上證指數收報3634點，跌21點，跌幅約0.6%；深證成份指數報10968點，跌229點，跌幅約2%；創業板指數報2426點，跌83點，跌幅逾3.3%。總結全星期，滬股跌0.4%，深證成指跌約1.9%，創業板指數跌約1.6%，全部扭轉前星期升勢。
summary.en: Mainland stocks closed lower, with the ChiNext index falling more sharply; computing hardware and component shares declined, while banks, insurers, baijiu, film and television, and pork shares performed well. The Shanghai Composite closed at 3,634, down 21 points or about 0.6 per cent; the Shenzhen Component Index closed at 10,968, down 229 points or about 2 per cent; the ChiNext Index closed at 2,426, down 83 points or more than 3.3 per cent. For the week, Shanghai stocks fell 0.4 per cent, the Shenzhen Component Index about 1.9 per cent and the ChiNext Index about 1.6 per cent, all reversing the previous week's gains.
summary.zh_hans: 内地股市低收，创业板指数跌幅较大；算力硬件及元件等股份下跌，银行、保险、白酒、影视及猪肉股造好。上证指数收报3634点，跌21点，跌幅约0.6%；深证成份指数报10968点，跌229点，跌幅约2%；创业板指数报2426点，跌83点，跌幅逾3.3%。总结全星期，沪股跌0.4%，深证成指跌约1.9%，创业板指数跌约1.6%，全部扭转前星期升势。

title.zh_hant: 瑪麗升降機風波　議員斥層層隱瞞　把關人如合上眼簽名　局方解畫
title.en: Mary Hospital lift saga: lawmakers slam layers of concealment, saying gatekeepers signed off with eyes shut
title.zh_hans: 玛丽升降机风波　议员斥层层隐瞒　把关人如合上眼签名　局方解画

summary.zh_hant: 立法會發展事務委員會討論瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程問題調查報告。建築署署長李翹彥表示，去年7月因大樓升降機發生工業意外，才知道更多項目情況；去年底找獨立註冊升降機工程師檢查，結論是「有瑕疵、符合法例、可繼續運行」；今年3月聘請廣東省特種設備檢測研究院詳細檢測，才得悉升降機井道有偏差及工藝欠妥。機電署署長潘國英表示，去年2月檢查L3升降機發現金屬切割，覺得事態嚴重，當時首次知道安裝有工程問題，隨即暫時吊銷涉事工程師註冊資格並展開調查。民建聯陳學鋒形容事件為「完美風暴」，一層隱瞞一層；陳凱欣批評把關的人像合上眼照簽名，又質疑為何直至今年9月發展局才首次提到井道問題。發展局局長甯漢豪表示，發展局一直無參與工程監管，直至今年3月底至4月初醫務衞生局反映問題，當時未知原因及如何處理，認為若當時告訴公眾但不知原因並非負責任做法。
summary.en: The Legislative Council's Panel on Development discussed the investigation report into the lift works at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block. Director of Architectural Services Lee Kiu-yin said it was only after an industrial accident involving the block's lifts in July last year that the department learned more about the project; an independent registered lift engineer engaged late last year concluded the lifts were "defective, compliant with the law and fit to continue operating"; and only after a detailed inspection by Guangdong's special equipment inspection institute in March this year did it emerge that the lift shafts were misaligned and the workmanship poor. Director of Electrical and Mechanical Services Pan Kwok-ying said that when the department inspected lift L3 in February last year and found cut metal, it realised the matter was serious and learned for the first time that there were installation problems, and immediately suspended the registration of the engineer involved and launched an investigation. DAB lawmaker Chan Hok-fung described the incident as a "perfect storm", with one layer of concealment on top of another; Election Committee constituency lawmaker Chan Hoi-yan criticised those responsible for oversight as having signed off with their eyes shut, and questioned why the Development Bureau only first mentioned the shaft problem in September this year. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the bureau had never been involved in supervising the works, and only learned of the problems from the Health Bureau in late March to early April this year, when the cause and the remedy were still unknown; she said telling the public then without knowing the cause would not have been responsible.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会发展事务委员会讨论玛丽医院新临床大楼升降机工程问题调查报告。建筑署署长李翘彦表示，去年7月因大楼升降机发生工业意外，才知道更多项目情况；去年底找独立注册升降机工程师检查，结论是「有瑕疵、符合法例、可继续运行」；今年3月聘请广东省特种设备检测研究院详细检测，才得悉升降机井道有偏差及工艺欠妥。机电署署长潘国英表示，去年2月检查L3升降机发现金属切割，觉得事态严重，当时首次知道安装有工程问题，随即暂时吊销涉事工程师注册资格并展开调查。民建联陈学锋形容事件为「完美风暴」，一层隐瞒一层；陈凯欣批评把关的人像合上眼照签名，又质疑为何直至今年9月发展局才首次提到井道问题。发展局局长甯汉豪表示，发展局一直无参与工程监管，直至今年3月底至4月初医务卫生局反映问题，当时未知原因及如何处理，认为若当时告诉公众但不知原因并非负责任做法。

title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案續審　鄺港傑：從未親眼見屍首殘肢　膠袋內有疑似骨頭湯渣
title.en: Choi Tin-fung trial continues: Kwong Kong-kit says he never saw the body or remains, and a bag held bone-like soup residue
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案续审　邝港杰：从未亲眼见尸首残肢　胶袋内有疑似骨头汤渣

summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案在高等法院續審，首被告、蔡天鳳的前大伯鄺港傑繼續作供，表示自己與父親鄺球和弟弟鄺港智無計劃在2023年2月21日殺害蔡天鳳或對她造成非常嚴重身體傷害，自己從來沒有親眼目擊蔡天鳳的屍首和殘肢。鄺港傑說，案發翌日晚上跟隨父親到大埔村屋，見到廚房爐頭有兩個煲正在加熱，但無查找煲內情況，鋅盤有紅蘿蔔和青蘿蔔；當晚再在洗手間協助父親清潔刀具，聽到切割聲音，但沒有與父親對話。鄺港傑又說，案發後曾經將廚房外的黑色膠袋打結包好，連同染血手套和紙巾掉出村屋外的大型垃圾箱，見到袋內有類似骨頭及青、紅蘿蔔的湯渣。對於警方在電鋸說明書和村屋雪櫃發現他的指紋，鄺港傑解釋，最後一次打開雪櫃是案發之前，事發前兩星期父親已經購買電鋸，自己曾經掀開說明書。
summary.en: The Choi Tin-fung murder trial continued at the High Court, with first defendant Kwong Kong-kit, the victim's former brother-in-law, continuing his testimony, saying he, his father Kwong Kau and his brother Kwong Kong-chi had no plan to kill Choi Tin-fung or cause her really serious bodily harm on February 21, 2023, and that he never saw Choi's body or remains with his own eyes. Kwong said that on the evening after the incident he followed his father to a Tai Po village house, where he saw two pots heating on the kitchen stove but did not check what was inside, and carrots in the sink; later that night he helped his father clean knives in the bathroom, hearing cutting sounds, without speaking to his father. He also said that after the incident he tied up a black plastic bag outside the kitchen, together with blood-stained gloves and tissues, and threw it into a large rubbish bin outside the village house, seeing bone-like matter and red and green carrot soup residue inside the bag. On police finding his fingerprints on a chainsaw manual and on the village house fridge, Kwong explained that the last time he opened the fridge was before the incident, and that his father had bought the chainsaw two weeks earlier, with Kwong having flipped through the manual himself.
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案在高等法院续审，首被告、蔡天凤的前大伯邝港杰继续作供，表示自己与父亲邝球和弟弟邝港智无计划在2023年2月21日杀害蔡天凤或对她造成非常严重身体伤害，自己从来没有亲眼目击蔡天凤的尸首和残肢。邝港杰说，案发翌日晚上跟随父亲到大埔村屋，见到厨房炉头有两个煲正在加热，但无查找煲内情况，锌盘有红萝卜和青萝卜；当晚再在洗手间协助父亲清洁刀具，听到切割声音，但没有与父亲对话。邝港杰又说，案发后曾经将厨房外的黑色胶袋打结包好，连同染血手套和纸巾掉出村屋外的大型垃圾箱，见到袋内有类似骨头及青、红萝卜的汤渣。对于警方在电锯说明书和村屋雪柜发现他的指纹，邝港杰解释，最后一次打开雪柜是案发之前，事发前两星期父亲已经购买电锯，自己曾经掀开说明书。

title.zh_hant: 強積金修例刊憲　拖供款120日未清加徵10%附加費　違規受託人最高罰1000萬
title.en: MPF amendment bill gazetted: employers 120 days in arrears face extra 10% surcharge; rogue trustees fined up to HK$10 million
title.zh_hans: 强积金修例刊宪　拖供款120日未清加征10%附加费　违规受托人最高罚1000万

summary.zh_hant: 政府今日刊憲《2026年強制性公積金計劃（修訂）條例草案》，加強追討拖欠強積金供款及完善強積金規管制度。草案建議引入兩級附加費機制：僱主除咗要繳現有5%附加費，如果喺供款日後第120日之前仍未繳清欠款及首級附加費，須就欠款總額另繳10%第二級附加費；積金局亦可書面要求僱主喺不少於14日內提供僱員收入資料，違者可被處定額罰款。草案同時建議賦權積金局制裁違規受託人，包括罰款最高1,000萬港元或違規所得利潤或避免損失的三倍（以較高者為準）、公開譴責或兩者兼施，並公開執法行動及加強規管中介人，以及放寬強積金投資管理彈性。草案將於11月25日提交立法會首讀。
summary.en: The Government gazetted the Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes (Amendment) Bill 2026 today to strengthen the recovery of default MPF contributions and improve the MPF regulatory regime. The bill proposes a two-tier surcharge: on top of the existing 5 per cent surcharge, employers who have not settled arrears and the first-tier surcharge in full before the 120th day after the contribution day must pay a second-tier surcharge of 10 per cent on the total amount in arrears; the MPFA may also require employers in writing to provide employee income information within no less than 14 days, with a fixed penalty for non-compliance. The bill would empower the MPFA to sanction non-compliant trustees with fines of up to HK$10 million or three times the profit gained or loss avoided, whichever is higher, a public reprimand, or both, and to disclose enforcement actions and tighten regulation of intermediaries, as well as relax MPF investment management flexibility. The bill will be introduced into the Legislative Council for its first reading on November 25.
summary.zh_hans: 政府今日刊宪《2026年强制性公积金计划（修订）条例草案》，加强追讨拖欠强积金供款及完善强积金规管制度。草案建议引入两级附加费机制：雇主除了要缴现有5%附加费，如果在供款日后第120日之前仍未缴清欠款及首级附加费，须就欠款总额另缴10%第二级附加费；积金局亦可书面要求雇主在不少于14日内提供雇员收入资料，违者可被处定额罚款。草案同时建议赋权积金局制裁违规受托人，包括罚款最高1,000万港元或违规所得利润或避免损失的三倍（以较高者为准）、公开谴责或两者兼施，并公开执法行动及加强规管中介人，以及放宽强积金投资管理弹性。草案将于11月25日提交立法会首读。

title.zh_hant: 習近平：國企黨建要持之以恆從嚴治黨　為做強做優做大國企提供保障
title.en: Xi Jinping: party building in state enterprises must keep advancing strict governance, to underpin stronger, better and bigger SOEs
title.zh_hans: 习近平：国企党建要持之以恒从严治党　为做强做优做大国企提供保障

summary.zh_hant: 中共中央總書記、國家主席、中央軍委主席習近平對國有企業黨的建設工作作出重要指示，強調要持之以恆推進全面從嚴治黨，為做強做優做大國有企業和國有資本提供堅強保障。國有企業黨的建設工作座談會在北京召開，會上傳達習近平重要指示，指出要著力完善中國特色現代企業制度，推動黨的領導更好融入公司治理各環節；著力增強黨組織政治功能和組織功能，促進黨建工作與生產經營深度融合；著力加強領導班子建設，鍛造高素質專業化幹部人才隊伍；著力落實管黨治黨政治責任，堅定不移正風肅紀反腐，營造風清氣正、幹事創業的良好氛圍。
summary.en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, gave important instructions on party building in state-owned enterprises, stressing the need to persistently advance full and strict governance of the Party to provide strong safeguards for making state enterprises and state capital stronger, better and bigger. A symposium on party building in state enterprises was held in Beijing, where Xi's instructions were conveyed: efforts should focus on improving the modern enterprise system with Chinese characteristics, better integrating Party leadership into all aspects of corporate governance; strengthening the political and organisational functions of Party organisations and deepening the integration of party building with production and operations; building leadership teams and a high-quality professional cadre and talent pool; and implementing the political responsibility for Party governance, unswervingly upholding integrity and fighting corruption to foster a clean and enterprising atmosphere.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平对国有企业党的建设工作作出重要指示，强调要持之以恒推进全面从严治党，为做强做优做大国有企业和国有资本提供坚强保障。国有企业党的建设工作座谈会在北京召开，会上传达习近平重要指示，指出要着力完善中国特色现代企业制度，推动党的领导更好融入公司治理各环节；着力增强党组织政治功能和组织功能，促进党建工作与生产经营深度融合；着力加强领导班子建设，锻造高素质专业化干部人才队伍；着力落实管党治党政治责任，坚定不移正风肃纪反腐，营造风清气正、干事创业的良好氛围。

title.zh_hant: 臺日升降機醜聞再發酵　機電署：有機會永久吊銷牌照　已報案查欺詐
title.en: Tai Yat lift scandal deepens: EMSD says it may permanently revoke the firm's licence, fraud already reported to police
title.zh_hans: 台日升降机丑闻再发酵　机电署：有机会永久吊销牌照　已报案查欺诈

summary.zh_hant: 立法會發展事務委員會特別會議討論臺日電梯漏裝720部升降機耐火門框組件事件。機電工程署總機電工程師吳玉華表示，臺日已提出執修補救方案，署方確認有效，預計臺日本月中完成兩個屋邨的執修工程，其餘會在兩至三個月內完成，署方會謹慎檢查每部升降機，確保合規完成安裝；署方已就懷疑涉嫌欺詐及虛假陳述的刑事行為報案。機電署署長潘國英表示，署方正就事件蒐證及徵詢律政司意見，可能會提出檢控及召開紀律聆訊，有機會永久吊銷臺日電梯的牌照。發展局局長甯漢豪指出，事件是臺日電梯的責任，機電署亦有百分百審查，但現場審查集中在安全部件，升降機有無安裝耐火門框是依賴升降機工程師確認；當局日後會調節相關驗收制度，預計機電署在年底前完成審視。
summary.en: A special meeting of the Legislative Council's Panel on Development discussed the Tai Yat Elevator case, in which 720 lifts were found without the required fire-resistant door frame assemblies. EMSD chief electrical and mechanical engineer Ng Yuk-wah said Tai Yat has proposed a rectification plan that the department has confirmed workable, with works at two public housing estates expected to finish by mid-month and the rest within two to three months; the department will inspect every lift carefully to ensure compliant installation, and has reported suspected fraud and false statements to police. EMSD director Pan Kwok-ying said the department is gathering evidence and seeking legal advice, and may prosecute and hold disciplinary hearings, with permanent revocation of Tai Yat's licence possible. Development Secretary Bernadette Linn said the incident was Tai Yat's responsibility, adding that while EMSD carries out full checks, on-site inspections focus on safety components and whether door frames were installed relies on lift engineers' confirmation; the acceptance regime will be adjusted, with EMSD's review expected to finish by year-end.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会发展事务委员会特别会议讨论台日电梯漏装720部升降机耐火门框组件事件。机电工程署总机电工程师吴玉华表示，台日已提出执修补救方案，署方确认有效，预计台日本月中完成两个屋邨的执修工程，其余会在两至三个月内完成，署方会谨慎检查每部升降机，确保合规完成安装；署方已就怀疑涉嫌欺诈及虚假陈述的刑事行为报案。机电署署长潘国英表示，署方正就事件搜证及征询律政司意见，可能会提出检控及召开纪律聆讯，有机会永久吊销台日电梯的牌照。发展局局长甯汉豪指出，事件是台日电梯的责任，机电署亦有百分百审查，但现场审查集中在安全部件，升降机有无安装耐火门框是依赖升降机工程师确认；当局日后会调节相关验收制度，预计机电署在年底前完成审视。

title.zh_hant: 聯儲局減會唔等於轉鴿　華僑銀行：政策仍數據為本　加息定價或升溫
title.en: Fed cutting meetings does not mean a dovish turn, OCBC says: policy stays data-dependent, rate-hike pricing may rise
title.zh_hans: 联储局减会不等于转鸽　华侨银行：政策仍数据为本　加息定价或升温

summary.zh_hant: 華僑銀行香港經濟師姜靜表示，市場對美國聯儲局明年將利率決策會議減至7次、10月會議改為專門討論貨幣政策戰略並不意外，主席沃什上任以來，貨幣政策決定依然「數據為本」，並無明顯鴿派傾向，調整會議次數不會改變政策方向和立場。她相信10月進行戰略討論，主要是配合研究進程和報告時間，並非刻意遷就特定經濟數據。姜靜估計，缺少聯儲局提供的經濟預測，市場將更加依賴經濟數據，重點數據公布當日利率市場單日波動性會較大；如果通脹上升或持續高企，金融市場的「加息定價」可能較高。
summary.en: OCBC Hong Kong economist Jiang Jing said markets were not surprised that the US Federal Reserve will cut its 2027 rate-setting meetings to seven, with the October meeting turned into a strategy discussion, noting that under Chair Walsh policy decisions remain data-dependent with no clear dovish tilt, and the change will not alter the policy direction. She said the October strategy session mainly fits the research schedule and is not timed to particular data. With no Fed economic projections, markets will lean more heavily on economic data, she added, warning of bigger single-day rate-market swings on key data days and higher rate-hike pricing if inflation stays elevated.
summary.zh_hans: 华侨银行香港经济师姜静表示，市场对美国联储局明年将利率决策会议减至7次、10月会议改为专门讨论货币政策战略并不意外，主席沃什上任以来，货币政策决定依然“数据为本”，并无明显鸽派倾向，调整会议次数不会改变政策方向和立场。她相信10月进行战略讨论，主要是配合研究进程和报告时间，并非刻意迁就特定经济数据。姜静估计，缺少联储局提供的经济预测，市场将更加依赖经济数据，重点数据公布当日利率市场单日波动性会较大；如果通胀上升或持续高企，金融市场的“加息定价”可能较高。

title.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案續審　鄺港傑：聽到刀具切割聲一度哭泣　全晚不敢離開洗手間
title.en: Choi Tin-fung case continues: Kwong Kong-kit says he wept hearing knife-cutting sounds and dared not leave the bathroom all night
title.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案续审　邝港杰：听到刀具切割声一度哭泣　全晚不敢离开洗手间

summary.zh_hant: 蔡天鳳案在高等法院續審，首被告、蔡天鳳前大伯鄺港傑繼續作供。他說案發當晚在龍尾村村屋洗手間，見到企缸內的膠箱有兩把刀具用水浸泡，其中一把刀和企缸地下有血跡，父親鄺球指示他清潔刀具和企缸，又提醒他戴上手套、穿雨褸和雨靴。鄺港傑說當晚一直不敢離開洗手間，見到父親在廚房和放置蔡天鳳屍首的房間之間手持水桶來回走動，自己全晚沒有睡覺，聽到刀具切割聲音時一度哭泣。他否認曾向蔡天鳳母親張燕花聲稱蔡天鳳與朋友去飲酒，強調自己完全無講過。翌日清晨他由父親接載離開村屋，到荃灣取車送蔡天鳳的兒子上學，再去深水埗洗車，父親帶著數袋冥鏹會合，稱一同去拜祭，兩人其後前往將軍澳墳場。
summary.en: The Choi Tin-fung murder trial continued at the High Court, with first defendant Kwong Kong-kit, the victim's former brother-in-law, continuing his testimony. He said that on the night of the incident, in the bathroom of a Lung Mei village house, he saw two knives soaking in water inside a plastic box in the shower, with blood on one knife and on the shower floor, and that his father Kwong Kau told him to clean the knives and the shower, reminding him to wear gloves, a raincoat and rain boots. Kwong said he dared not leave the bathroom all night, watching his father carry a bucket back and forth between the kitchen and the room where Choi's body lay, and that he wept when he heard knife-cutting sounds. He denied telling Choi's mother that Choi had gone drinking with friends. Early the next morning his father drove him from the village house to pick up a car in Tsuen Wan to take Choi's son to school, then to Sham Shui Po to wash the car, where his father arrived with bags of joss paper to pay respects together before heading to the Tseung Kwan O cemetery.
summary.zh_hans: 蔡天凤案在高等法院续审，首被告、蔡天凤前大伯邝港杰继续作供。他说案发当晚在龙尾村村屋洗手间，见到企缸内的胶箱有两把刀具用水浸泡，其中一把刀和企缸地下有血迹，父亲邝球指示他清洁刀具和企缸，又提醒他戴上手套、穿雨褛和雨靴。邝港杰说当晚一直不敢离开洗手间，见到父亲在厨房和放置蔡天凤尸首的房间之间手持水桶来回走动，自己全晚没有睡觉，听到刀具切割声音时一度哭泣。他否认曾向蔡天凤母亲张燕花声称蔡天凤与朋友去饮酒，强调自己完全无讲过。翌日清晨他由父亲接载离开村屋，到荃湾取车送蔡天凤的儿子上学，再去深水埗洗车，父亲带着数袋冥镪会合，称一同去拜祭，两人其后前往将军澳坟场。

title.zh_hant: 恒指半日瀉222點失守23800　科指跌近2%　AI股先升後回
title.en: Hang Seng Index down 222 points at midday, below 23,800, as tech index falls nearly 2% and AI stocks give up early gains
title.zh_hans: 恒指半日泻222点失守23800　科指跌近2%　AI股先升后回

summary.zh_hant: 港股連跌3日，恒生指數在24000點以下整固，曾經跌逾230點，中午收市報23786點，跌222點，跌幅0.92%，半日主板成交額逾935億元。科技指數跌近2%，報3863點，ATMXJ多數下跌，騰訊和小米跌逾2%，京東集團靠穩。人工智能概念股及國產GPU股先升後回，智譜跌近9%，MINIMAX跌近7%；天數智芯一度急升逾15%，半日倒跌近1%。中芯國際業績後曾升逾7%，半日升幅收窄至0.5%。內房和本地地產股都下跌，龍湖集團跌近半成，中海外跌逾3%。三桶油升近1%至近3%，以中石油升幅較大。
summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a third straight day, with the Hang Seng Index consolidating below 24,000, at one point down more than 230 points, closing the morning session at 23,786, down 222 points or 0.92%, with main-board turnover of over HK$93.5 billion. The tech index fell nearly 2% to 3,863, with most ATMXJ stocks lower — Tencent and Xiaomi down more than 2% while JD.com held steady. AI concept and domestic GPU stocks gave up early gains, with Zhipu down nearly 9% and MiniMax down nearly 7%; Tianshu Zhixin surged more than 15% at one point before ending the morning down nearly 1%. SMIC rose more than 7% after results before narrowing to a 0.5% gain. Mainland property and local developers fell, Longfor down nearly 5% and China Overseas down more than 3%, while the three oil majors rose 1% to nearly 3%, led by PetroChina.
summary.zh_hans: 港股连跌3日，恒生指数在24000点以下整固，曾经跌逾230点，中午收市报23786点，跌222点，跌幅0.92%，半日主板成交额逾935亿元。科技指数跌近2%，报3863点，ATMXJ多数下跌，腾讯和小米跌逾2%，京东集团靠稳。人工智能概念股及国产GPU股先升后回，智谱跌近9%，MINIMAX跌近7%；天数智芯一度急升逾15%，半日倒跌近1%。中芯国际业绩后曾升逾7%，半日升幅收窄至0.5%。内房和本地地产股都下跌，龙湖集团跌近半成，中海外跌逾3%。三桶油升近1%至近3%，以中石油升幅较大。

title.zh_hant: 亞殘運港隊41面獎牌凱旋　李家超嘉許：永不言敗香港精神
title.en: Hong Kong Asian Para Games team returns with 41 medals as Chief Executive John Lee praises their never-give-up spirit
title.zh_hans: 亚残运港队41面奖牌凯旋　李家超嘉许：永不言败香港精神

summary.zh_hant: 第五屆亞洲殘疾人運動會中國香港代表團嘉許禮今日舉行，行政長官李家超頒發嘉許狀。李家超致辭表示，中國香港代表團今屆派出超過150人，包括80名精英運動員出戰多個比賽項目，贏得3金14銀24銅，合共41面獎牌，表現卓越。他表示運動員的奮力拼搏，充分展現香港殘疾運動員的實力和風采，運動員以行動證明，真正的強大在於不斷堅持、敢於突破，展現堅韌不屈、永不言敗的香港精神。李家超又說，特區政府一直支持殘疾人士參與體育活動，2026/27年度政府就培訓殘疾精英運動員向體院提供約7100萬元，預算開支較5年前增加超過五成；自去年4月起，政府將所有精英運動員包括殘疾運動員的直接資助額全面調升8.3%，同時在殘疾運動精英級別中增設成年隊級別，進一步完善培訓階梯。
summary.en: The commendation ceremony for Hong Kong, China's delegation to the 5th Asian Para Games was held today, with Chief Executive John Lee presenting commendations. Lee said the delegation sent more than 150 people, including 80 elite athletes, winning 3 gold, 14 silver and 24 bronze medals — 41 in total — in an outstanding performance. He said the athletes' efforts fully demonstrated the strength and spirit of Hong Kong's para athletes, proving through action that true strength lies in perseverance and daring to break through, embodying the never-give-up Hong Kong spirit. Lee added that the government continues to support people with disabilities in sport, providing about HK$71 million to the Hong Kong Sports Institute in 2026/27 for training elite para athletes, up more than 50% from five years ago; since April last year, direct funding for all elite athletes, including para athletes, has been raised by 8.3%, with a new adult squad level added for para sports.
summary.zh_hans: 第五届亚洲残疾人运动会中国香港代表团嘉许礼今日举行，行政长官李家超颁发嘉许状。李家超致辞表示，中国香港代表团今届派出超过150人，包括80名精英运动员出战多个比赛项目，赢得3金14银24铜，合共41面奖牌，表现卓越。他表示运动员的奋力拼搏，充分展现香港残疾运动员的实力和风采，运动员以行动证明，真正的强大在于不断坚持、敢于突破，展现坚韧不屈、永不言败的香港精神。李家超又说，特区政府一直支持残疾人士参与体育活动，2026/27年度政府就培训残疾精英运动员向体院提供约7100万元，预算开支较5年前增加超过五成；自去年4月起，政府将所有精英运动员包括残疾运动员的直接资助额全面调升8.3%，同时在残疾运动精英级别中增设成年队级别，进一步完善培训阶梯。

title.zh_hant: 房委會放寬資助出售單位　初生嬰家庭按揭可借95%　轉售限期縮短至10年
title.en: Housing Authority eases subsidised sale flat rules: newborn families can borrow up to 95%, resale restriction cut to 10 years
title.zh_hans: 房委会放宽资助出售单位　初生婴家庭按揭可借95%　转售限期缩短至10年

summary.zh_hant: 香港房屋委員會資助房屋小組今日通過兩項資助出售單位優化措施，協助市民置業安居。第一，由下一期居者有其屋計劃銷售起，有初生嬰兒的白表家庭申請者最高按揭成數由90%提高至95%，與綠表看齊；在相關居屋銷售計劃申請截止日期時子女年齡為3歲或以下的家庭均可受惠。第二，將2022至2025年首次推售的資助出售單位轉讓限制期由15年縮短至10年，鼓勵更多業主沿置業階梯向上流動；新單位已按2025年《施政報告》由首次轉讓日期起計15年縮短至10年，並自「出售居屋單位2025」及「出售綠表置居計劃單位2025」起實施。房委會發言人表示，兩項新措施有助更多家庭向上流動，同時促進資助出售單位流轉，全面協助市民置業。
summary.en: The Hong Kong Housing Authority's Subsidised Housing Committee today approved two enhancement measures for subsidised sale flats to help the public buy homes. First, starting from the next Home Ownership Scheme sale exercise, the maximum mortgage loan-to-value ratio for White Form family applicants with newborns will rise from 90% to 95%, in line with Green Form applicants; all families whose children are aged three or below at the application deadline will benefit. Second, the alienation restriction period for subsidised sale flats first put up for sale between 2022 and 2025 will be shortened from 15 years to 10 years, encouraging homeowners to move up the housing ladder; new flats have already had the period cut from 15 to 10 years from the date of first assignment under the 2025 Policy Address, implemented since the Sale of HOS Flats 2025 and Sale of Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme Flats 2025 exercises. A Housing Authority spokesman said the two measures will help more families move up while promoting turnover of subsidised sale flats.
summary.zh_hans: 香港房屋委员会资助房屋小组今日通过两项资助出售单位优化措施，协助市民置业安居。第一，由下一期居者有其屋计划销售起，有初生婴儿的白表家庭申请者最高按揭成数由90%提高至95%，与绿表看齐；在相关居屋销售计划申请截止日期时子女年龄为3岁或以下的家庭均可受惠。第二，将2022至2025年首次推售的资助出售单位转让限制期由15年缩短至10年，鼓励更多业主沿置业阶梯向上流动；新单位已按2025年《施政报告》由首次转让日期起计15年缩短至10年，并自“出售居屋单位2025”及“出售绿表置居计划单位2025”起实施。房委会发言人表示，两项新措施有助更多家庭向上流动，同时促进资助出售单位流转，全面协助市民置业。

title.zh_hant: 中芯全年收入料破120億美元　趙海軍：AI需求勁　明年業務積極正面
title.en: SMIC expects full-year revenue to top US$12 billion as Zhao Haijun says AI demand is strong and next year's outlook is positive
title.zh_hans: 中芯全年收入料破120亿美元　赵海军：AI需求劲　明年业务积极正面

summary.zh_hant: 中芯國際預計今年全年收入有望超過120億美元，按年升近30%，毛利率約26%，按年擴大約5個百分點。聯合首席執行官趙海軍表示，人工智能及數據中心配套相關產品仍然供不應求，客戶需求繼續增長，產能缺口仍在擴大，中高端產品需求未有減弱，對明年業務看法積極正面。他說AI發展方興未艾，帶來不少新行業，有不少企業透過建立自己的小型數據中心提高效率。不過趙海軍說，當前全球半導體設備供應鏈緊張，交付周期拉長，部分設備交付時間不確定，雖然不影響擴充產能規劃落地，但會影響全年資本開支落實。他說正透過提升營運效率對沖材料費用成本上升等挑戰，但目前產能利用率已相當高，未來仍可能要與客戶商討分擔成本，估計AI配套產品以及汽車和工業領域產品價格或保持穩健向上趨勢。
summary.en: SMIC expects full-year revenue to exceed US$12 billion, up nearly 30% year on year, with gross margin of about 26%, up about 5 percentage points. Co-chief executive officer Zhao Haijun said products linked to AI and data-centre infrastructure remain in short supply, customer demand keeps growing and the capacity gap is widening, with no weakening in demand for mid- to high-end products, and he is positive about next year's business. He said AI development is still in its early stages and is creating new industries, with many companies building their own small data centres to boost efficiency. However, Zhao said the global semiconductor equipment supply chain is tight, with longer delivery times and uncertainty over some deliveries, which will not stop capacity expansion plans but will affect full-year capital expenditure. He said the company is offsetting rising material costs through better operating efficiency, but capacity utilisation is already very high and it may need to discuss cost-sharing with customers, with prices for AI-related, automotive and industrial products likely to stay on a steady upward trend.
summary.zh_hans: 中芯国际预计今年全年收入有望超过120亿美元，按年升近30%，毛利率约26%，按年扩大约5个百分点。联合首席执行官赵海军表示，人工智能及数据中心配套相关产品仍然供不应求，客户需求继续增长，产能缺口仍在扩大，中高端产品需求未有减弱，对明年业务看法积极正面。他说AI发展方兴未艾，带来不少新行业，有不少企业透过建立自己的小型数据中心提高效率。不过赵海军说，当前全球半导体设备供应链紧张，交付周期拉长，部分设备交付时间不确定，虽然不影响扩充产能规划落地，但会影响全年资本开支落实。他说正透过提升营运效率对冲材料费用成本上升等挑战，但目前产能利用率已相当高，未来仍可能要与客户商讨分担成本，估计AI配套产品以及汽车和工业领域产品价格或保持稳健向上趋势。

title.zh_hant: 國星宇航落戶香港設國際總部　孫東：歡迎更多硬科技企業嚟港
title.en: Guoxing Aerospace to set up international headquarters in Hong Kong, Sun Dong says more hard-tech firms are welcome
title.zh_hans: 国星宇航落户香港设国际总部　孙东：欢迎更多硬科技企业来港

summary.zh_hant: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東出席國星宇航上市儀式並致辭，他說國星宇航是一家人工智能與商業航天深度融合的硬科技企業，很高興這家企業已經與香港科技園公司簽署合作協議，將在香港設立國際總部與研發中心。他指出，國星宇航早前宣布與一家以香港為總部的人工智能企業合作，共建太空算力星座，示範香港的金融和科技「雙賦能」作用如何幫助企業尋找新突破，同時回應香港第一個五年規劃中拓展航天科技等領域應用發展的方向。孫東又說，歡迎更多硬科技企業善用香港「超級聯絡人」和「超級增值人」優勢，開闢更多新賽道，向世界展示國家和香港創科的強大實力與價值。
summary.en: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong attended the listing ceremony of Guoxing Aerospace, saying the hard-tech company, which deeply integrates AI with commercial aerospace, has signed a cooperation agreement with the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation to set up its international headquarters and a research and development centre in Hong Kong. He noted Guoxing Aerospace earlier announced a partnership with a Hong Kong-headquartered AI company to jointly build a space computing constellation, demonstrating how Hong Kong's finance and technology twin engines can help companies find new breakthroughs, while aligning with the first five-year plan's direction of expanding aerospace technology applications. Sun said more hard-tech companies are welcome to leverage Hong Kong's advantages as a super-connector and super value-adder to open new tracks and showcase the strength of the nation's and Hong Kong's innovation and technology.
summary.zh_hans: 创新科技及工业局局长孙东出席国星宇航上市仪式并致辞，他说国星宇航是一家人工智能与商业航天深度融合的硬科技企业，很高兴这家企业已经与香港科技园公司签署合作协议，将在香港设立国际总部与研发中心。他指出，国星宇航早前宣布与一家以香港为总部的人工智能企业合作，共建太空算力星座，示范香港的金融和科技“双赋能”作用如何帮助企业寻找新突破，同时回应香港第一个五年规划中拓展航天科技等领域应用发展的方向。孙东又说，欢迎更多硬科技企业善用香港“超级联络人”和“超级增值人”优势，开辟更多新赛道，向世界展示国家和香港创科的强大实力与价值。

title.zh_hant: 瑪麗醫院升降機醜聞發酵　議員逼啟動二級調查　甯漢豪拒認制度出事
title.en: Mary Hospital lift scandal escalates as lawmakers press for second-level probe; Ning Hanhao rejects systemic failure claim
title.zh_hans: 玛丽医院升降机丑闻发酵　议员逼启动二级调查　甯汉豪拒认制度出事

summary.zh_hant: 發展局向立法會發展事務委員會交代瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程問題調查報告，多名議員對事件感到失望及匪夷所思，有議員要求啟動牽涉部門首長或政策局常任秘書長等高層角色的第二級調查。選委會界別議員林振昇關注是否要啟動「部門首長責任制」第二級調查，發展局局長甯漢豪表示，發現制度上有不足，不會自動啟動第二級調查，但如果有關首長是長時間不去處理、導致更多問題發生，便要考慮啟動。選委會界別議員陳曼琪認為監工及驗收正是部門及部門首長要建立管理系統，不同意事件不涉及廣泛系統性問題，又批評報告前後矛盾，促請啟動第二級調查，甯漢豪回應說不同意報告前後矛盾，也不能同意個別人員執行得不好就指是制度問題，今次事件不是因為沒有制度，但確有可改善地方。她表示發展局是今年4月醫衞局希望發展局介入才知悉事件，強調發展局不是每個工務工程的監察方。
summary.en: The Development Bureau briefed the Legislative Council's Panel on Development on its investigation into the lift works at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block, with several lawmakers expressing disappointment and calling for a second-level investigation involving department heads or permanent secretaries. Election Committee lawmaker Lam Chun-sing asked whether the second level of the department-head accountability system should be triggered. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said shortcomings had been found in the system but a second-level probe would not start automatically, though it would be considered if a department head had failed to act over a long period and caused more problems. Lawmaker Chan Man-ki argued that supervision and acceptance are exactly what departments and their heads must systematise, disagreed that the case involved no wider systemic issues, criticised the report as contradictory and urged a second-level investigation. Linn disagreed that the report was contradictory and said poor execution by individuals did not amount to a systemic problem, though there was room for improvement. She said the bureau only learned of the matter in April this year when the Health Bureau asked it to intervene, stressing the bureau is not the monitor of every public works project.
summary.zh_hans: 发展局向立法会发展事务委员会交代玛丽医院新临床大楼升降机工程问题调查报告，多名议员对事件感到失望及匪夷所思，有议员要求启动牵涉部门首长或政策局常任秘书长等高层角色的第二级调查。选委会界别议员林振昇关注是否要启动“部门首长责任制”第二级调查，发展局局长甯汉豪表示，发现制度上有不足，不会自动启动第二级调查，但如果有关首长是长时间不去处理、导致更多问题发生，便要考虑启动。选委会界别议员陈曼琪认为监工及验收正是部门及部门首长要建立管理系统，不同意事件不涉及广泛系统性问题，又批评报告前后矛盾，促请启动第二级调查，甯汉豪回应说不同意报告前后矛盾，也不能同意个别人员执行得不好就指是制度问题，今次事件不是因为没有制度，但确有可改善地方。她表示发展局是今年4月医衞局希望发展局介入才知悉事件，强调发展局不是每个工务工程的监察方。

title.zh_hant: 醫療產品監管中心條例草案刊憲　11月25日首讀　盧寵茂：打造國際認可監管機構
title.en: Centre for Medical Products Regulation Bill gazetted, first reading on November 25; Lo Chung-mau aims for an internationally recognised regulator
title.zh_hans: 医疗产品监管中心条例草案刊宪　11月25日首读　卢宠茂：打造国际认可监管机构

summary.zh_hant: 《醫療產品監管中心條例草案》今日刊憲，確立醫療產品監管中心（CMPR）的法定地位，並理順中西藥及日後醫療器械的規管框架。醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，成立CMPR是香港醫療產品規管改革的重要里程碑，政府將全面對接國家「十五五」規劃，建立積極主動的醫療產品評審及審批機制，讓先進產品更快引入香港，惠及病人，並將香港發展成為國際健康及醫療創新樞紐。條例草案主要建議包括：成立CMPR為法人團體，代表中國香港參與醫療產品規管國際事務，與全球領先監管機構建立正式長遠的工作關係；以現行法例為基礎，將現時屬於藥劑業及毒藥管理局、香港中醫藥管理委員會中藥組及其委員會的中西藥，以及日後醫療器械的相關規管權力及職能，轉移至衞生署署長，以統一規管框架；以及加強相關支援機制並作出必要的技術修訂。政府今年4月已就相關立法建議諮詢立法會衞生事務委員會，條例草案將於11月25日提交立法會首讀。
summary.en: The Centre for Medical Products Regulation Bill was gazetted today to establish the statutory status of the Centre for Medical Products Regulation (CMPR) and rationalise the regulatory framework for Chinese and Western medicines as well as medical devices in the future. Secretary for Health Professor Lo Chung-mau said the establishment of the CMPR marks a significant milestone in Hong Kong's regulatory reform of medical products, adding the government will align with the National 15th Five-Year Plan and set up a proactive mechanism for evaluating and approving medical products so advanced products can reach Hong Kong more quickly for patients' benefit, developing Hong Kong into an international health and medical innovation hub. Major proposals include establishing the CMPR as a body corporate to represent Hong Kong, China in international regulatory affairs and build formal, long-term working relationships with leading regulators worldwide; transferring the regulatory powers and functions for Chinese and Western medicines currently vested in the Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Hong Kong, the Chinese Medicines Board of the Chinese Medicine Council of Hong Kong and their committees, and those for medical devices after future legislation, to the Director of Health to unify the framework; and enhancing supporting mechanisms with necessary technical amendments. The government consulted the Legislative Council Panel on Health Services in April this year, and the Bill will be introduced for its First Reading on November 25.
summary.zh_hans: 《医疗产品监管中心条例草案》今日刊宪，确立医疗产品监管中心（CMPR）的法定地位，并理顺中西药及日后医疗器械的规管框架。医务衞生局局长卢宠茂表示，成立CMPR是香港医疗产品规管改革的重要里程碑，政府将全面对接国家“十五五”规划，建立积极主动的医疗产品评审及审批机制，让先进产品更快引入香港，惠及病人，并将香港发展成为国际健康及医疗创新枢纽。条例草案主要建议包括：成立CMPR为法人团体，代表中国香港参与医疗产品规管国际事务，与全球领先监管机构建立正式长远的工作关系；以现行法例为基础，将现时属于药剂业及毒药管理局、香港中医药管理委员会中药组及其委员会的中西药，以及日后医疗器械的相关规管权力及职能，转移至衞生署署长，以统一规管框架；以及加强相关支援机制并作出必要的技术修订。政府今年4月已就相关立法建议咨询立法会衞生事务委员会，条例草案将于11月25日提交立法会首读。

title.zh_hant: 澤連斯基開條件：和談必須談停火　歡迎歐洲入場　普京拒外軍駐烏
title.en: Zelensky sets terms: peace talks must cover a ceasefire, Europe welcome at the table, while Putin rejects foreign troops in Ukraine
title.zh_hans: 泽连斯基开条件：和谈必须谈停火　欢迎欧洲入场　普京拒外军驻乌

summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭總統澤連斯基周四表示，對歐洲代表出席下一輪美國斡旋的俄烏和平談判表示歡迎，並希望議程能包括旨在實現停火並緩和衝突的措施。澤連斯基在與美國特使威特科夫和總統女婿庫什納會談後表示，日前在阿布扎比舉行九個月以來的首次會談後，和平進程得以重啟，這一點至關重要；烏方決定制定一份議程，內容涉及任何形式的緩和局勢、某種形式的停火。威特科夫和庫什納較早時在莫斯科與俄羅斯總統普京會晤。普京表明，華盛頓必須搞清楚歐洲到底希望烏克蘭實現和平，抑或繼續戰爭，強調俄羅斯不接受外國軍隊駐紮烏克蘭。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Thursday he welcomes European representatives at the next round of US-brokered Russia-Ukraine peace talks and hopes the agenda will include measures aimed at achieving a ceasefire and de-escalating the conflict. After meeting US envoy Steve Witkoff and presidential son-in-law Jared Kushner, Zelensky said the first talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi had restarted the peace process, which was crucial, and that Kyiv would draw up an agenda covering any form of de-escalation and a ceasefire. Witkoff and Kushner had earlier met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Putin said Washington must work out whether Europe wants peace for Ukraine or continued war, stressing that Russia does not accept foreign troops stationed in Ukraine.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基周四表示，对欧洲代表出席下一轮美国斡旋的俄乌和平谈判表示欢迎，并希望议程能包括旨在实现停火并缓和冲突的措施。泽连斯基在与美国特使威特科夫和总统女婿库什纳会谈后表示，日前在阿布扎比举行九个月以来的首次会谈后，和平进程得以重启，这一点至关重要；乌方决定制定一份议程，内容涉及任何形式的缓和局势、某种形式的停火。威特科夫和库什纳较早时在莫斯科与俄罗斯总统普京会晤。普京表明，华盛顿必须搞清楚欧洲到底希望乌克兰实现和平，抑或继续战争，强调俄罗斯不接受外国军队驻扎乌克兰。

title.zh_hant: 鼠患投訴10個月破1.1萬宗　逼近全年總數　觀塘工廈捉近60隻老鼠
title.en: Rat complaints top 11,000 in ten months, nearly a full year's total; about 60 rats caught in Kwun Tong factory building
title.zh_hans: 鼠患投诉10个月破1.1万宗　逼近全年总数　观塘工厦捉近60只老鼠

summary.zh_hant: 食環署今年頭10個月共接獲約1萬1千宗涉及鼠患的投訴，數目已相等於以往全年約1萬1千宗的水平。食環署助理署長潘炳揚表示，投訴增加主要涉及環境因素，例如食肆及街市處理廚餘有疏漏，加上傳媒及社交媒體廣泛報道，帶動公眾關注。署方本月4日起展開針對公園及綠化地帶的「雷霆行動」，精準找出老鼠匿藏處以毒殺及誘捕，再封閉鼠洞；觀塘一幢工廠大廈接獲投訴後署方發出十多張通知仍無改善，派員介入捕獲近60隻老鼠，當局會考慮檢控及追收行動開支。
summary.en: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department received about 11,000 rat-related complaints in the first ten months of this year, already matching the roughly 11,000 received in a typical full year. Assistant Director Poon Ping-yeung said the rise was mainly down to environmental factors, such as food premises and markets mishandling food waste, as well as extensive media and social media coverage raising public awareness. The department launched a Thunder Operation on November 4 targeting parks and vegetated areas, pinpointing rat hiding places to poison and trap them before sealing the holes; at a Kwun Tong factory building, more than ten notices brought no improvement and officers caught nearly 60 rats, with prosecution and recovery of the operation's costs now under consideration.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署今年头10个月共接获约1万1千宗涉及鼠患的投诉，数目已相等于以往全年约1万1千宗的水平。食环署助理署长潘炳扬表示，投诉增加主要涉及环境因素，例如食肆及街市处理厨余有疏漏，加上传媒及社交媒体广泛报道，带动公众关注。署方本月4日起展开针对公园及绿化地带的「雷霆行动」，精准找出老鼠匿藏处以毒杀及诱捕，再封闭鼠洞；观塘一幢工厂大厦接获投诉后署方发出十多张通知仍无改善，派员介入捕获近60只老鼠，当局会考虑检控及追收行动开支。

title.zh_hant: 新世界停牌傳供股250億　彭博：銀行研軟包底　集資計劃或告吹
title.en: New World halted amid reported HK$25 billion rights issue: Bloomberg says banks weigh soft underwriting, plan may yet fall through
title.zh_hans: 新世界停牌传供股250亿　彭博：银行研软包底　集资计划或告吹

summary.zh_hant: 新世界發展（0017）今日早上九時起暫停股份及債務證券交易，以待公布內幕消息。據彭博通訊社報道，公司正考慮進行一項高達250億港元的供股集資，已聘請銀行籌備，以強化資產負債表及應付到期債務。銀行正考慮以「軟包底」方式安排是次股份發行，即嘗試尋找外部投資者，而非承諾動用自身資金購入任何未獲認購的股份；消息人士透露，相關討論仍在進行，供股計劃最終亦可能不付諸實行。另外，上月有報道指私募股權公司貝恩資本正探索向新世界發展注入資金，方案同時涉及鄭氏家族提供新資金；另一私募股權公司黑石亦曾考慮注資，但據報因鄭氏家族拒絕放棄控股權而被擱置。
summary.en: New World Development (0017) suspended trading in its shares and debt securities from 9 a.m. today pending an announcement of inside information. Bloomberg reported that the company is considering a rights issue of up to HK$25 billion and has engaged banks to prepare the fundraising, to strengthen its balance sheet and meet maturing debt. Banks are considering a "soft underwriting" arrangement, under which they would seek outside investors rather than commit their own funds to buy up any unsubscribed shares; people familiar with the matter said discussions are ongoing and the rights issue may ultimately not proceed. Separately, reports last month said private equity firm Bain Capital was exploring an injection into New World, with the Cheng family also providing fresh capital; another private equity firm, Blackstone, had also considered an investment but reportedly shelved it after the Cheng family refused to give up control.
summary.zh_hans: 新世界发展（0017）今日早上九时起暂停股份及债务证券交易，以待公布内幕消息。据彭博通讯社报道，公司正考虑进行一项高达250亿港元的供股集资，已聘请银行筹备，以强化资产负债表及应付到期债务。银行正考虑以“软包底”方式安排是次股份发行，即尝试寻找外部投资者，而非承诺动用自身资金购入任何未获认购的股份；消息人士透露，相关讨论仍在进行，供股计划最终亦可能不付诸实行。另外，上月有报道指私募股权公司贝恩资本正探索向新世界发展注入资金，方案同时涉及郑氏家族提供新资金；另一私募股权公司黑石亦曾考虑注资，但据报因郑氏家族拒绝放弃控股权而被搁置。

title.zh_hant: 微軟大死機逾5小時　Outlook、Teams齊癱　OpenAI都受波及
title.en: Microsoft outage lasts over five hours; Outlook and Teams go down, OpenAI hit too
title.zh_hans: 微软大死机逾5小时　Outlook、Teams齐瘫　OpenAI都受波及

summary.zh_hant: 微軟多項服務於當地星期四發生大面積故障，持續超過5小時，大批用戶受影響。微軟表示，故障原因是多台伺服器因負載過高意外離線，公司正盡可能將流量轉移至其他路徑，同時簡化流程令伺服器恢復上線。受影響服務包括Microsoft 365、Outlook、Teams及其他應用程式，連OpenAI及Anthropic人工智能服務所使用的連接組件亦受波及；微軟稱已觀察到有限恢復，用戶正逐步重新連接。
summary.en: Multiple Microsoft services suffered a widespread outage on Thursday local time lasting more than five hours, affecting large numbers of users. Microsoft said several servers had unexpectedly gone offline because of excessive load, and the company was diverting traffic to other routes where possible while simplifying processes to bring servers back online. Affected services included Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams and other applications, and connection components used by the AI services of OpenAI and Anthropic were also hit; Microsoft said limited recovery had been observed and users were gradually reconnecting.
summary.zh_hans: 微软多项服务于当地星期四发生大面积故障，持续超过5小时，大批用户受影响。微软表示，故障原因是多台服务器因负载过高意外离线，公司正尽可能将流量转移至其他路径，同时简化流程令服务器恢复上线。受影响服务包括Microsoft 365、Outlook、Teams及其他应用程式，连OpenAI及Anthropic人工智能服务所使用的连接组件亦受波及；微软称已观察到有限恢复，用户正逐步重新连接。

title.zh_hant: 恒指初段跌124點　國星宇航首掛升2%
title.en: Hang Seng opens 124 points lower; Guoxing Aerospace gains 2% on debut
title.zh_hans: 恒指初段跌124点　国星宇航首挂升2%

summary.zh_hant: 港股今早開市初段向下，恒生指數較早時報23,884點，跌124點，跌幅0.52%；科技指數報3,931點，跌不足1點。中國商業航天企業國星宇航首日掛牌，較早時報25.4元，較招股價高2%。
summary.en: Hong Kong stocks opened lower this morning, with the Hang Seng Index at 23,884 points, down 124 points or 0.52%, while the tech index stood at 3,931 points, down less than a point. Chinese commercial aerospace firm Guoxing Aerospace debuted today, trading at 25.4 yuan, 2% above its offer price.
summary.zh_hans: 港股今早开市初段向下，恒生指数较早时报23,884点，跌124点，跌幅0.52%；科技指数报3,931点，跌不足1点。中国商业航天企业国星宇航首日挂牌，较早时报25.4元，较招股价高2%。

title.zh_hant: 觀塘凌晨血案　酒吧口角尾隨斬人　56歲男左臂中刀昏迷　兇徒逃脫
title.en: Kwun Tong stabbing: bar row ends in knife attack in the early hours; 56-year-old man left unconscious, attacker on the run
title.zh_hans: 观塘凌晨血案　酒吧口角尾随斩人　56岁男左臂中刀昏迷　兇徒逃脱

summary.zh_hant: 今日凌晨約1時，一名56歲姓陳男子在觀塘輔仁街建豐大廈樓梯懷疑被刀襲擊，左前臂有約8厘米傷口，一度失去知覺，送往伊利沙伯醫院治理後恢復知覺。警方初步調查指，傷者早前在觀塘道一間酒吧與一名五六十歲男子因眼神及態度問題爭執，對方尾隨傷者到大廈，以生果刀施襲後逃去。案件列作傷人案，由觀塘警區重案組第四隊跟進，警方正追緝一名約50歲中國籍男子，暫未有人被捕，並呼籲目擊者及駕駛人士提供車cam片段。
summary.en: At about 1am today, a 56-year-old man surnamed Chan was stabbed on a stairwell at Kin Fung Building on Fu Yan Street in Kwun Tong, suffering an approximately eight-centimetre cut to his left forearm and briefly losing consciousness; he regained consciousness after treatment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Police said the victim had earlier argued with a man in his fifties or sixties in a bar on Kwun Tong Road over perceived looks and attitude, and the man followed him to the building and attacked him with a fruit knife before fleeing. The case is classified as wounding and is being handled by Team 4 of the Kwun Tong District Crime Squad; officers are seeking a Chinese man believed to be around 50, no arrests have been made, and witnesses and drivers with dashcam footage are urged to come forward.
summary.zh_hans: 今日凌晨约1时，一名56岁姓陈男子在观塘辅仁街建丰大厦楼梯怀疑被刀袭击，左前臂有约8厘米伤口，一度失去知觉，送往伊利沙伯医院治理后恢复知觉。警方初步调查指，伤者早前在观塘道一间酒吧与一名五六十岁男子因眼神及态度问题争执，对方尾随伤者到大厦，以生果刀施袭后逃去。案件列作伤人案，由观塘警区重案组第四队跟进，警方正追缉一名约50岁中国籍男子，暂未有人被捕，并呼吁目击者及驾驶人士提供车cam片段。

title.zh_hant: 2027鄉郊選舉刊憲　村代表1月17日投票　提名11月24日開鑼
title.en: 2027 Rural Ordinary Election gazetted; village representative polls on January 17, nominations open November 24
title.zh_hans: 2027乡郊选举刊宪　村代表1月17日投票　提名11月24日开锣

summary.zh_hant: 政府今日刊憲公布2027年鄉郊一般選舉投票日期：村代表選舉（包括原居民代表及居民代表）將於2027年1月17日（星期日）舉行，市鎮街坊代表選舉則於2027年1月24日（星期日）舉行；提名期由今年11月24日至12月7日。現時全港共有709條鄉村、1,484個村代表議席，包括695個居民代表議席及789個原居民代表議席。政府發言人呼籲合資格人士參與選舉，投票通知書將於投票日前最少10日寄予每名合資格選民。
summary.en: The Government gazetted today the polling dates for the 2027 Rural Ordinary Election: the Village Representative Election (covering Indigenous Inhabitant Representatives and Resident Representatives) will be held on Sunday, January 17, 2027, and the Kaifong Representative Election for Market Towns on Sunday, January 24, 2027, with nominations running from November 24 to December 7 this year. There are currently 709 villages and 1,484 Village Representative seats, including 695 Resident Representative and 789 Indigenous Inhabitant Representative seats. A government spokesman appealed to eligible electors to take part, with polling notices to be issued at least 10 days before polling day.
summary.zh_hans: 政府今日刊宪公布2027年乡郊一般选举投票日期：村代表选举（包括原居民代表及居民代表）将于2027年1月17日（星期日）举行，市镇街坊代表选举则于2027年1月24日（星期日）举行；提名期由今年11月24日至12月7日。现时全港共有709条乡村、1,484个村代表议席，包括695个居民代表议席及789个原居民代表议席。政府发言人呼吁合资格人士参与选举，投票通知书将于投票日前最少10日寄予每名合资格选民。

title.zh_hant: 台股初段飆逾2%　加權指數升1107點報44199點
title.en: Taiwan stocks jump more than 2% in early trade; weighted index up 1,107 points at 44,199
title.zh_hans: 台股初段飙逾2%　加权指数升1107点报44199点

summary.zh_hant: 台灣股市今早開市初段升逾2%，加權指數較早時報44,199點，升1,107點，升幅2.57%。
summary.en: Taiwan stocks rose more than 2% in early trading this morning, with the weighted index at 44,199 points, up 1,107 points or 2.57%.
summary.zh_hans: 台湾股市今早开市初段升逾2%，加权指数较早时报44,199点，升1,107点，升幅2.57%。

title.zh_hant: 習近平下周三深圳主持APEC峰會　將發表重要講話　工商峰會同場舉行
title.en: Xi Jinping to chair APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen next Wednesday and deliver keynote address; business summit held alongside
title.zh_hans: 习近平下周三深圳主持APEC峰会　将发表重要讲话　工商峰会同场举行

summary.zh_hant: 國家主席習近平將於下星期三至四在深圳出席亞太經合組織第三十三次領導人非正式會議及相關活動，會議主題是「建設亞太共同體，促進共同繁榮」，習近平將主持會議並發表講話。亞太經合組織工商領導人峰會將於下星期二至三在深圳舉行，主題是「共促繁榮，共贏未來」，習近平將出席開幕式並發表主旨演講。會議期間，習近平還將為與會各經濟體領導人或代表舉行歡迎宴會，並同外國領導人舉行雙邊會晤。
summary.en: President Xi Jinping will attend the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and related events in Shenzhen next Wednesday and Thursday, under the theme of building an Asia-Pacific community and promoting common prosperity; Xi will chair the meeting and deliver an address. The APEC CEO Summit will be held in Shenzhen next Tuesday and Wednesday under the theme of promoting prosperity and win-win cooperation, with Xi attending the opening ceremony and delivering a keynote speech. During the meetings, Xi will also host a welcome banquet for leaders and representatives of member economies and hold bilateral meetings with foreign leaders.
summary.zh_hans: 国家主席习近平将于下星期三至四在深圳出席亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议及相关活动，会议主题是「建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣」，习近平将主持会议并发表讲话。亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会将于下星期二至三在深圳举行，主题是「共促繁荣，共赢未来」，习近平将出席开幕式并发表主旨演讲。会议期间，习近平还将为与会各经济体领导人或代表举行欢迎宴会，并同外国领导人举行双边会晤。

title.zh_hant: 美財政部上季買入794億日圓救市　遏日圓急貶　日本同期干預15.4萬億
title.en: US Treasury bought 79.4 billion yen last quarter to prop up the currency; Japan intervened with 15.4 trillion yen in the same period
title.zh_hans: 美财政部上季买入794亿日圆救市　遏日圆急贬　日本同期干预15.4万亿

summary.zh_hant: 紐約聯儲銀行發布貨幣市場操作季度報告，披露美國財政部於第3季買入日圓，遏制日圓急劇貶值，期間聯儲局本身未有在外匯市場干預。報告指，紐約聯儲於7月31日在即期市場買入794億日圓，折合約4.97億美元，資金來自出售外匯穩定基金中的歐元；日本財務省同期亦採取協同行動，於上季實施15.4萬億日圓干預。美元兌日圓於7月30日至8月3日期間由約163日圓跌至約155日圓，其後日圓再度回軟，重新逼近160水平。
summary.en: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York's quarterly report on money market operations disclosed that the US Treasury bought yen in the third quarter to curb the yen's sharp depreciation, while the Federal Reserve itself did not intervene in the foreign exchange market during the period. The report said the New York Fed bought 79.4 billion yen, about US$497 million, in the spot market on July 31, funded by selling euros from the Exchange Stabilization Fund; Japan's Ministry of Finance also took concerted action, intervening with 15.4 trillion yen in the same quarter. The US dollar fell from about 163 yen to about 155 yen between July 30 and August 3, before the yen softened again towards 160.
summary.zh_hans: 纽约联储银行发布货币市场操作季度报告，披露美国财政部于第3季买入日圆，遏制日圆急剧贬值，期间联储局本身未有在外汇市场干预。报告指，纽约联储于7月31日在即期市场买入794亿日圆，折合约4.97亿美元，资金来自出售外汇稳定基金中的欧元；日本财务省同期亦采取协同行动，于上季实施15.4万亿日圆干预。美元兑日圆于7月30日至8月3日期间由约163日圆跌至约155日圆，其后日圆再度回软，重新逼近160水平。

title.zh_hant: 陳智思：西九要靠商業養文化　門票租場永遠唔夠收支平衡
title.en: Bernard Chan: West Kowloon must let commerce fund culture; ticket and venue income can never break even
title.zh_hans: 陈智思：西九要靠商业养文化　门票租场永远不够收支平衡

summary.zh_hant: 西九文化區管理局董事局主席陳智思表示，會銳意將西九變為文化及商業中心，因為文化事業需要資金支持才能持續，兩者需要共存。陳智思接受電視節目訪問時表示，西九的文化設施例如博物館及表演場所已落成，但商業部分未建好，出現很大收入與虧損的時差；門票及租場收益遠不足以達致收支平衡，香港完全靠商業補貼。國家「十五五」規劃表明支持香港深化建設「中外文化藝術交流中心」，陳智思表示香港可透過策展，讓海外遊客聽得明、看得明白中國文化，是香港獨特之處。
summary.en: West Kowloon Cultural District Authority chairman Bernard Chan said he is determined to turn West Kowloon into a cultural and commercial hub, because cultural endeavours need funding to be sustainable and the two must coexist. In a television interview, Chan said the district's cultural facilities, such as museums and performance venues, are complete, but the commercial parts are not yet built, creating a large timing gap between income and losses; ticket and venue-hire income falls far short of breaking even, and Hong Kong relies entirely on commercial subsidy. The national 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong in deepening its role as an East-meets-West centre for international cultural exchange, and Chan said Hong Kong's curating can help overseas visitors understand Chinese culture, which is the city's unique strength.
summary.zh_hans: 西九文化区管理局董事局主席陈智思表示，会锐意将西九变为文化及商业中心，因为文化事业需要资金支持才能持续，两者需要共存。陈智思接受电视节目访问时表示，西九的文化设施例如博物馆及表演场所已落成，但商业部分未建好，出现很大收入与亏损的时差；门票及租场收益远不足以达致收支平衡，香港完全靠商业补贴。国家「十五五」规划表明支持香港深化建设「中外文化艺术交流中心」，陈智思表示香港可透过策展，让海外游客听得明、看得明白中国文化，是香港独特之处。

title.zh_hant: 深圳APEC｜設計之都文創佔GDP約8%　華僑城文創園成大灣區地標
title.en: Shenzhen APEC: design capital's creative industries make up about 8% of GDP; OCT-LOFT a Greater Bay Area landmark
title.zh_hans: 深圳APEC｜设计之都文创占GDP约8%　华侨城文创园成大湾区地标

summary.zh_hant: 即將舉行APEC峰會的深圳被譽為「中國設計之都」，文化創意業是深圳四大支柱產業之一，佔全市GDP大約8%。位於南山區的華僑城創意文化園是大灣區文化地標之一，有近300間機構進駐，涵蓋當代藝術、工藝及設計等多個範疇。園內設計公司舉辦展覽，展出漆器、古玉、古劍、老傢俱及石窟壁畫書籍等，希望透過APEC國際平台讓更多人認識中國傳統非物質文化遺產工藝，例如「中國四大名錦」之一的廣西壯錦。園區前身是八、九十年代的工業區，2006年改建為文創園，現時每月第一及第三個周末舉辦文創市集。
summary.en: Shenzhen, which is about to host the APEC summit, is known as China's City of Design, and its cultural and creative industries are one of the city's four pillar industries, accounting for about 8% of GDP. The OCT-LOFT creative culture park in Nanshan District is a Greater Bay Area cultural landmark, home to nearly 300 organisations spanning contemporary art, crafts and design. Design studios in the park are staging exhibitions of lacquerware, ancient jade, old swords, antique furniture and books on grotto murals, hoping the APEC platform will introduce more people to traditional Chinese intangible cultural heritage crafts such as Guangxi brocade, one of China's four famous brocades. The park was converted from an industrial area of the 1980s and 1990s and opened as a creative park in 2006, hosting creative markets on the first and third weekends of each month.
summary.zh_hans: 即将举行APEC峰会的深圳被誉为「中国设计之都」，文化创意业是深圳四大支柱产业之一，占全市GDP大约8%。位于南山区的华侨城创意文化园是大湾区文化地标之一，有近300间机构进驻，涵盖当代艺术、工艺及设计等多个范畴。园内设计公司举办展览，展出漆器、古玉、古剑、老家俱及石窟壁画书籍等，希望透过APEC国际平台让更多人认识中国传统非物质文化遗产工艺，例如「中国四大名锦」之一的广西壮锦。园区前身是八、九十年代的工业区，2006年改建为文创园，现时每月第一及第三个周末举办文创市集。

title.zh_hant: 瑪麗新大樓升降機頻故障　甯漢豪：承建商首責　紀律調查啟動
title.en: Queen Mary Hospital's new block lifts keep breaking down; Bernadette Linn blames contractors first, disciplinary probes launched
title.zh_hans: 玛丽新大楼升降机频故障　甯汉豪：承建商首责　纪律调查启动

summary.zh_hant: 立法會發展事務委員會舉行特別會議，討論瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機工程問題調查報告。發展局局長甯漢豪表示，新大樓28部升降機有多部經常發生故障，情況不尋常；事件首要責任是承建商及分判商未有做好本份，負責監察的專業人士及政府人員在管理及監察亦有不足，雖然不涉及系統性問題，但制度有優化空間。局方建議建築署署長就政府人員啟動紀律調查，涉事承建商、分判商、顧問公司及人員亦會按適用機制啟動紀律程序，懷疑可能涉及刑事成份的環節已轉介執法部門跟進。升降機執修進度良好，預計今年第四季完成餘下執修，但大樓全面開放要延遲。
summary.en: The Legislative Council's Panel on Development held a special meeting on the investigation report into lift works at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block. Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said several of the block's 28 lifts had frequently broken down, which was unusual, and that primary responsibility lay with the contractors and subcontractors for failing in their duties, while the professionals and government staff responsible for supervision also fell short in management and monitoring, though there was no systemic problem and the system could be improved. The bureau recommended the Director of Architectural Services launch a disciplinary investigation into government staff, with disciplinary procedures also to be started against the contractors, subcontractors, consultants and personnel involved, and suspected criminal elements referred to law enforcement. Lift rectification is progressing well and should be completed in the fourth quarter of this year, but the full opening of the block will be delayed.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会发展事务委员会举行特别会议，讨论玛丽医院新临床大楼升降机工程问题调查报告。发展局局长甯汉豪表示，新大楼28部升降机有多部经常发生故障，情况不寻常；事件首要责任是承建商及分判商未有做好本份，负责监察的专业人士及政府人员在管理及监察亦有不足，虽然不涉及系统性问题，但制度有优化空间。局方建议建筑署署长就政府人员启动纪律调查，涉事承建商、分判商、顾问公司及人员亦会按适用机制启动纪律程序，怀疑可能涉及刑事成份的环节已转介执法部门跟进。升降机执修进度良好，预计今年第四季完成余下执修，但大楼全面开放要延迟。

title.en: Chinese micro-dramas sweep overseas markets, taking 82 of the top 100; UK becomes Europe's biggest audience
title.zh_hans: 中国短剧席卷海外　百大榜占82部　英国成欧洲最大观众市场

summary.zh_hant: 手機微短劇熱潮擴展至海外。有數據顯示，上月份全球海外微短劇前100大排行榜，有82部由中國業界推出。今年上半年，印尼、印度、巴西、菲律賓和墨西哥是海外短劇應用程式下載量最大的5個國家，佔近六成半；而美國、日本、韓國、英國和巴西則是付費短劇淨收入最大的5個國家，英國成為歐洲最大觀眾市場。
summary.en: The micro-drama boom on mobile phones is spreading overseas. Data shows that 82 of the top 100 overseas micro-dramas last month were produced by the Chinese industry. In the first half of this year, Indonesia, India, Brazil, the Philippines and Mexico were the five countries with the most overseas short-drama app downloads, accounting for nearly 65%, while the United States, Japan, South Korea, the United Kingdom and Brazil generated the most paid short-drama revenue, with the UK becoming the largest audience market in Europe.
summary.zh_hans: 手机微短剧热潮扩展至海外。有数据显示，上月份全球海外微短剧前100大排行榜，有82部由中国业界推出。今年上半年，印尼、印度、巴西、菲律宾和墨西哥是海外短剧应用程式下载量最大的5个国家，占近六成半；而美国、日本、韩国、英国和巴西则是付费短剧净收入最大的5个国家，英国成为欧洲最大观众市场。

title.zh_hant: 柴灣倫常血案　31歲男疑為錢反目　擸雙刀斬63歲母　重案組跟進
title.en: Chai Wan family tragedy: 31-year-old man suspected of attacking his 63-year-old mother with two knives over money, major crime squad investigates
title.zh_hans: 柴湾伦常血案　31岁男疑为钱反目　擸双刀斩63岁母　重案组跟进

summary.zh_hant: 柴灣發生兒子斬傷母親案件。昨日（12日）傍晚6時許，警方接獲一名31歲姓黃的本地男子報案，聲稱自己在柴灣興華（一）邨卓華樓的住所內，情緒失控用刀襲擊其63歲姓盧的母親。警方與救護員趕抵涉事單位時，發現盧婦頭、頸及手部均有多處刀傷，當時仍然清醒，隨即由救護車急送東區醫院治理。警方經初步搜查後，在單位內當場檢獲兩把涉案的兇器，分別為長約25厘米及27厘米的菜刀。警方隨即以涉嫌「傷人」罪名將31歲的黃姓男子拘捕，現正將其扣留調查。據了解，這宗倫常血案起因疑因金錢糾紛，涉案母子當時在寓所內懷疑因金錢糾紛發生激烈口角，其間兒子情緒失控，拿出雙刀向母親施襲。由於案情嚴重，警方已將案件交由東區警區重案組接手跟進，正進一步調查兩人的金錢糾紛細節。
summary.en: A son attacked his mother with knives in Chai Wan. At around 6pm yesterday (November 12), police received a report from a 31-year-old local man surnamed Wong, who said he had lost control and attacked his 63-year-old mother surnamed Lo with knives at their flat in Cheuk Wah House, Hing Wah (I) Estate, Chai Wan. Police and paramedics found the mother with multiple knife wounds to her head, neck and hands; she was conscious and was rushed to Eastern Hospital. Officers seized two cleavers at the scene, measuring about 25cm and 27cm long. The 31-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of wounding and is detained for investigation. It is understood the incident may have stemmed from a money dispute, with the pair having a heated argument at home before the son lost control and attacked his mother with two knives. Given the seriousness of the case, the Eastern District major crime squad has taken over the investigation.
summary.zh_hans: 柴湾发生儿子斩伤母亲案件。昨日（12日）傍晚6时许，警方接获一名31岁姓黄的本地男子报案，声称自己在柴湾兴华（一）邨卓华楼的住所内，情绪失控用刀袭击其63岁姓卢的母亲。警方与救护员赶抵涉事单位时，发现卢妇头、颈及手部均有多处刀伤，当时仍然清醒，随即由救护车急送东区医院治理。警方经初步搜查后，在单位内当场检获两把涉案的凶器，分别为长约25厘米及27厘米的菜刀。警方随即以涉嫌“伤人”罪名将31岁的黄姓男子拘捕，现正将其扣留调查。据了解，这宗伦常血案起因疑因金钱纠纷，涉案母子当时在寓所内怀疑因金钱纠纷发生激烈口角，其间儿子情绪失控，拿出双刀向母亲施袭。由于案情严重，警方已将案件交由东区警区重案组接手跟进，正进一步调查两人的金钱纠纷细节。

title.zh_hant: IMF：聯儲局需維持限制性貨幣政策　AI投資＋能源價格推高通脹
title.en: IMF says Fed must keep restrictive monetary policy as AI investment and energy prices drive inflation
title.zh_hans: IMF：联储局需维持限制性货币政策　AI投资＋能源价格推高通胀

summary.zh_hant: 國際貨幣基金組織表示，美國聯儲局仍需維持限制性貨幣政策立場，推動通脹回落至2%的目標水平，組織支持聯儲局以維護物價穩定作為政策重點。發言人科扎克表示，美國通脹並非由工資增長推動，主要是受到能源價格高企，以及人工智能投資熱潮持續的影響；她指人工智能股票估值仍面臨市場對其長期盈利能力重新評估的風險，目前判斷人工智能行業最新動向對通脹壓力的影響仍為時尚早。基金組織認為，人工智能投資和數據中心建設所帶來的需求增長，是推動美國通脹的兩大主要因素之一，另一因素是伊朗戰爭及霍爾木茲海峽封鎖導致的能源價格上升。
summary.en: The International Monetary Fund said the US Federal Reserve still needs to maintain a restrictive monetary policy stance to bring inflation back down to its 2% target, adding that it supports the Fed's focus on price stability. IMF spokesperson Julie Kozak said US inflation is not being driven by wage growth but mainly by high energy prices and the continuing boom in artificial intelligence investment; she said AI stock valuations still face the risk of markets reassessing their long-term profitability, and that it is too early to judge how the latest developments in the AI sector will affect inflationary pressures. The IMF sees demand growth from AI investment and data-centre construction as one of the two main drivers of US inflation, with the other being higher energy prices caused by the war involving Iran and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh_hans: 国际货币基金组织表示，美国联储局仍需维持限制性货币政策立场，推动通胀回落至2%的目标水平，组织支持联储局以维护物价稳定作为政策重点。发言人科扎克表示，美国通胀并非由工资增长推动，主要是受到能源价格高企，以及人工智能投资热潮持续的影响；她指人工智能股票估值仍面临市场对其长期盈利能力重新评估的风险，目前判断人工智能行业最新动向对通胀压力的影响仍为时尚早。基金组织认为，人工智能投资和数据中心建设所带来的需求增长，是推动美国通胀的两大主要因素之一，另一因素是伊朗战争及霍尔木兹海峡封锁导致的能源价格上升。

title.zh_hant: 美國10月預算赤字4040億美元創同月新高　按年急增42%
title.en: US October budget deficit hits record US$404 billion for the month, up 42% year on year
title.zh_hans: 美国10月预算赤字4040亿美元创同月新高　按年急增42%

summary.zh_hant: 美國財政部數據顯示，美國10月錄得4040億美元預算赤字，創同月紀錄新高，按年增加42%，因收入減少及支出急增所致。10月財政收入減少9%至3690億美元，其中海關淨稅收減少39%至192億美元。期內支出創同月新高，按年增加12%至7730億美元，來自農業救助補貼、軍費、營運、維護和採購等項目的支出都有所增加。
summary.en: US Treasury data show the United States recorded a budget deficit of US$404 billion in October, a record for the month and up 42% from a year earlier, as revenue fell and spending surged. Fiscal revenue in October fell 9% to US$369 billion, with net customs receipts down 39% to US$19.2 billion. Spending hit a record for the month, rising 12% year on year to US$773 billion, with higher outlays on farm aid subsidies, the military, operations, maintenance and procurement.
summary.zh_hans: 美国财政部数据显示，美国10月录得4040亿美元预算赤字，创同月纪录新高，按年增加42%，因收入减少及支出急增所致。10月财政收入减少9%至3690亿美元，其中海关净税收减少39%至192亿美元。期内支出创同月新高，按年增加12%至7730亿美元，来自农业救助补贴、军费、营运、维护和采购等项目的支出都有所增加。

Spot gold fell at one point to around US$3,852 an ounce, its lowest since early October last year and down 3.3%, and was later at US$3,879.71, down 2.7%. New York gold futures closed at US$3,885.30 an ounce, down nearly 2.9%.
summary.zh_hans: 金价跌至逾1年低位，连跌3个交易日，因美元触及逾1年半高位。现货金一度跌至每盎司3852美元水平，创去年10月初以来低位，跌幅3.3%，较早时报3879.71美元，跌幅2.7%。纽约期金收市报每盎司3885.3美元，跌幅近2.9%。

title.zh_hant: 油價飆近3%　沙特能源設施遇襲　霍爾木茲海峽航運受阻

title.zh_hans: 油价飙近3%　沙特能源设施遇袭　霍尔木兹海峡航运受阻
